jobs.title: Senior Manager, Corporate & International Tax
jobs.description:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About the Role

We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Manager to join Volta’s tax function and lead delivery across corporate and international tax. This role would suit someone looking to move in-house at a fast-scaling, capital-intensive platform.

Reporting to the VP of Tax, this is a hands-on delivery role. The Senior Manager will own the group’s corporate tax compliance and reporting workstreams, implement international tax policies, and monitor governance to ensure tax structures are operating as intended, with genuine scope for the remit to grow as the function and business scale.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Lead the day-to-day management of corporate tax compliance across the group, coordinating local Finance teams and external advisers to ensure accurate and timely filings.

  • Review corporate tax computations, returns and supporting schedules, escalating material positions and judgement calls to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain oversight of tax payments, instalments, filing obligations and elections across jurisdictions.

  • Own the preparation and coordination of current and deferred tax calculations, tax disclosures and supporting documentation for financial reporting and audit.

  • Build and maintain group cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, explaining key movements, risks and opportunities.

  • Track tax losses, capital allowances, interest restrictions and other tax attributes, ensuring they are reflected consistently in returns, reporting and forecasts.

International Tax

  • Execute the technical analysis and implementation of international tax policies and structures agreed with the VP of Tax.

  • Monitor the group’s permanent-establishment, tax-residence and substance positions as the business expands into new markets.

  • Manage withholding-tax and repatriation workstreams, including treaty relief, supporting documentation and coordination with local advisers.

  • Assess the corporate and international tax implications of new entities, cross-border activities and intercompany arrangements.

  • Support tax planning for intangible assets and intellectual property (IP), including ownership, development, licensing and cross-border transfers, working with the VP of Tax, Legal and external advisers to align arrangements with commercial objectives, substance and transfer-pricing requirements.

  • Monitor the group’s obligations under Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and other international tax reporting regimes, coordinating implementation and filings where applicable.

  • Bring forward clear recommendations on technical questions, with the commercial and risk trade-offs spelled out.

  • Flag material tax developments and translate them into practical actions for the group.

Transfer Pricing & Intercompany Arrangements

  • Lead the day-to-day implementation of the group’s transfer-pricing policies, working with Finance, Legal and external advisers.

  • Coordinate transfer-pricing documentation, benchmarking and local reporting requirements across jurisdictions.

  • Monitor intercompany charges and financing arrangements to ensure they reflect agreed policies, contractual terms and the activities performed.

  • Work with Finance to implement intercompany calculations, invoicing and year-end adjustments.

  • Maintain supporting documentation for intercompany services, financing, intellectual property and other material cross-border arrangements.

  • Identify changes in functions, assets or risks that may require updates to the group’s transfer-pricing approach.

Governance & Risk

  • Help operate Volta’s tax governance framework and controls on a day-to-day basis and keep the tax risk register current.

  • Build and maintain supporting documentation for material tax positions, elections and arrangements.

  • Monitor whether group structures are operating as intended, including governance, substance and intercompany arrangements.

  • Manage the working relationship with Big Four and legal advisers on corporate and international tax matters, escalating scope, cost or quality issues.

  • Coordinate responses to tax authority enquiries, audits and information requests, escalating significant matters to the VP of Tax.

  • Maintain clear ownership, deadlines and evidence of review across tax compliance and reporting processes.

Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day corporate and international tax contact for Finance, Legal, People and other internal teams.

  • Give practical, timely tax input on new markets, operating arrangements and business initiatives.

  • Support Capital Markets and Corporate Development on transactions, drawing on the group’s tax positions, attributes and compliance requirements.

  • Coordinate with colleagues and advisers responsible for VAT/GST, employment taxes and other specialist areas where issues overlap.

  • Prepare materials and analysis for the VP of Tax ahead of CFO, leadership, investor and auditor conversations.

  • Take ownership of agreed workstreams end-to-end, escalating judgement calls and anything strategically significant to the VP of Tax.

Process & Team Support

  • Help the VP of Tax roll out new processes, controls and systems as the function scales.

  • Improve the quality and availability of tax data, working closely with Finance on reporting and reconciliation processes.

  • Identify opportunities for automation and standardisation in tax compliance, reporting and intercompany processes.

  • Manage or mentor junior tax analysts and associates as the team grows.

About You

Experience & Qualifications

  • Strong relevant tax experience, typically Big Four Senior Manager to Associate Director level, or the in-house equivalent – someone used to taking ownership of corporate and international tax delivery across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Professional qualification: CTA, ACA, CA or equivalent.

  • Solid technical grounding in corporate and international tax, including transfer pricing, withholding taxes, permanent establishments, tax residence and treaty matters.

  • Hands-on experience managing corporate tax compliance and external advisers across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Proven experience with tax accounting, current and deferred tax provisions, and financial statement disclosures.

  • Comfortable building and reviewing cash-tax forecasts and effective tax rate analysis, and explaining the commercial implications.

  • Experience implementing tax policies and intercompany arrangements, with an understanding of the documentation and processes needed to make them work in practice.

Skills & Attributes

  • Execution-focused and detail-oriented, with good judgement about what to escalate and when.

  • Comfortable owning a workstream end-to-end while operating within a strategy set by someone else.

  • Strong project-management skills, coordinating multiple jurisdictions, deadlines and internal and external stakeholders at once.

  • A clear communicator, able to explain complex tax positions to non-tax audiences.

  • Pragmatic and collaborative, energised by building good process in a fast-moving environment.

  • Able to connect technical tax requirements with the group’s commercial activities, financial reporting and cash flow.

Desirable Experience

  • Background in private equity, infrastructure funds, real assets, energy or digital infrastructure.

  • Time in a start-up or rapidly scaling international organisation.

  • Exposure to data centres or other capital-intensive infrastructure businesses.

  • Familiarity with UK, European and US tax environments.

  • Experience with Pillar Two, country-by-country reporting and international tax transparency requirements.

  • Exposure to cross-border financing, restructurings or acquisitions.

What We Offer

About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Facilities Readiness Lead, you will set the standard for when a Volta facility is ready to receive network and compute. You will own the readiness criteria and release process that every DSX site uses to hand space over for installation and turn-up.

This is an expert-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will set direction across construction, commissioning, operations and deployment teams, and your recommendation will decide whether an area is released, conditionally released or held.

What you will do

Readiness standard

  • Own Volta's global facilities readiness standard: criteria, evidence, approvals and release process by building, hall or zone.

  • Set the governance for readiness decisions and exceptions across all sites.

  • Set requirements for access, safety, fire protection, housekeeping and temporary arrangements in live and phased sites.

Release decisions

  • Recommend release, conditional release or deferral to delivery leadership, and escalate readiness risks early.

  • Align readiness with GPU deployment, network delivery and turn-up dates.

  • Make sure asset information, drawings and operating instructions reach receiving teams.

Improvement

  • Use deployment lessons to evolve the standard.

What we are looking for

  • Expert-level experience in data centre construction, commissioning, facilities engineering or technical handover, typically 9 to 12 years.

  • A track record setting readiness or acceptance processes across multiple sites or teams.

  • Strong understanding of power, cooling, controls and physical infrastructure dependencies.

  • Sound judgement on readiness risk and confidence making release calls with senior stakeholders.

  • Ability to drive multiple disciplines to closure without direct authority.

Nice to have

  • Releasing facilities for high-density GPU installations.

  • Phased delivery in live or partially operational sites.

  • Repeatable acceptance processes across a portfolio.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

jobs.description:
Location: London – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior


About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

Your Role

We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. The UK is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, DACH, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In the UK we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years.

If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in the UK and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. You will report directly to the Co-founder, have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and a channel person alongside you to build the partner ecosystem. Your job is to generate pipeline, navigate deals, and close.

No VP of Sales between you and the decision maker. No committee to approve your approach. Just a big market, a working product, and room to run.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate pipeline fast - primarily through your existing network. There is no inbound engine, no SDR handing you leads. You eat what you kill.

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close

  • Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement

  • Be the face of Nebuly in the UK - at events, in conversations, in the market

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience in the UK

  • Proven track record of closing multiple 6-figure enterprise contracts

  • Active network of prospects and decision-makers in the the UK enterprise space

  • Comfortable in technical sales conversations (with CTOs, ML teams, data leads)

  • You know how to win deals without inbound or SDRs - you drive your own pipeline

  • Experience working alongside system integrators and advisory firms - you know how to bring them into a deal, co-sell with them, and build the relationship that eventually generates referrals.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, a lean process, and building as you go

  • Fluent in English

You do not need to have sold AI observability or conversational analytics before. You need to know the buyers and know how to sell.

Bonus Points

  • Experience as a first sales hire or market launcher

  • Background in data, analytics, ML infrastructure, or developer tools

What We Offer

A product with proof. You have a working product, enterprise logos, and a category narrative that resonates with exactly the buyers you will be calling.

Real earning potential. Compensation is flexible based on experience and fit.

Equity. You are early. That means something.

No bureaucracy. You will report directly to the Co-founder and have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and field marketing support to help with events. You will start by selling directly - but as you build the first logos in the UK, activating the first partner relationships is part of the job too. A dedicated Partnerships Manager joins once the market has validated. Until then, the partner motion is yours.


Sound like you? Apply now. We'd love to meet you.

jobs.description:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now.

Your work will contribute to turning advanced robotics into reliable, manufacturable and deployable technology for real-world industrial applications.

Don't see the right role?

Great people don't always fit neatly into an existing job description. If you're excited about what we're building but haven't found a suitable opening, we'd still love to hear from you!

We're always interested in meeting people who want to help shape the future of robotics and Physical AI, whether your expertise lies in:

  • Engineering & Robotics: Mechanical engineering, electronics, actuators, embedded systems, controls, robotics and system integration.

  • Software & AI: Robotics software, machine learning, perception, motion planning and software development.

  • Product & Industrialisation: Product development, testing, manufacturing, quality, reliability and technical operations.

  • Business & Commercial: Business development, sales, marketing, partnerships and customer success.

  • Operations & Corporate Functions: Supply chain, finance, people, administration and other areas that help a growing company succeed.

If you bring a different skill set that you believe could make a difference at TACTILIA, we want to hear from you.

What happens next?

Tell us a little about yourself, your experience and what you'd like to contribute to TACTILIA. Share your CV and, if available, your LinkedIn profile. Our team will review your application and get in touch if we see a potential match with our current or future opportunities. If there isn't an immediate fit, we'd be happy to stay connected for relevant opportunities down the road, subject to your consent.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.

Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.

If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that work reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.

Privacy & Talent Community

By submitting your application, you agree that TACTILIA may retain your application details for up to 12 months to consider you for future opportunities. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

jobs.title: Bankgata ungdomsskole - grunnskolelærer fransk
jobs.description:
Er du vår nye kollega?

Ved Bankgata ungdomsskole er det ledig 35 % stilling som grunnskolelærer med undervisning i fransk, vikariat ledig for tiltredelse f.o.m 26.11.26 t.o.m. 31.07.27.

Undervisningen er lagt til mandag og onsdag.

Bankgata ungdomsskole er en  8 -10 skole. Den er mottaksskole med eget innføringstilbud for nyankomne elever fra andre land og har i tillegg ansvaret for et skjermet kommunalt tilbud for elever med høyt fravær.

Skolen ligger i Bodø sentrum.

Bankgata ungdomsskole er i stadig utvikling og vi jobber målrettet og systematisk for å gi våre elever et godt skoletilbud. Bankgata er en universitetsskole og MOT-skole.

Gjennom arbeid med et trygt og godt skolemiljø har vi fokus på motivasjon og mestring i læring, samt gode relasjoner mellom voksne og barn. 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være

Undervisning i fransk på 8., 9. og 10. trinn.

Kvalifikasjoner

Undervisningskompetanse i fransk på ungdomstrinnet.

Beherske norsk språk muntlig og skriftlig.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som kan:

  • samarbeide med lærere og andre ansatte på teamet og skolen.
  • samarbeide med foresatte og andre samarbeidspartnere tilknyttet skolen.

Vi søker deg som er trygg, varm og anerkjennende i arbeidet med våre elever.

Det vil ved tilsetting bli lagt vekt på motivasjon for stillingen og personlig egnethet.

Annet

Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju.

Lønn etter gjeldende tariffavtale/avtale.

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema.

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis legges ved søknaden. 

Før tiltredelse må politiattest av ny dato forevises jf. Opplæringsloven § 17-11. (Skal ikke vedlegges søknaden.)

Arbeidsplassene i Bodø kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Fast ansatte i Bodø kommune med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsandel oppfordres til å søke. 

Bodø kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det. 

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste iht. Offentlighetsloven § 25 selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om. 

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale. Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på 6 måneder.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen?

Kontakt gjerne rektor Even Ågnes på tlf: 75 55 66 21, mobil: 957 23 502 eller e-post even.agnes@bodo.kommune.no.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bodø er den ultimate kombinasjonen av kultur og natur, lokalisert midt mellom storslåtte naturperler i regionen rundt. Vi er uredde, har trua, er gode på samhandling og utvikler nye og smarte løsninger.

Våre medarbeidere får det til å skje. En jobb i kommunen er en jobb med mening, hvor det du gjør betyr noe for innbyggerne – og gjør Bodø til et godt sted å leve.

jobs.title: Arealplanleggjar - 100% fast
jobs.description:
Om stillinga og tenesteområdet

Alversamfunnet er i rivande utvikling og vi treng ein arealplanleggjar/sakshandsamar som ser moglegheitene i plan- og bygningslova sin formålsparagraf om berekraftig utvikling til beste for den einskilde, samfunnet og framtidige generasjonar. I løpet av den kommande 10-årsperioden er det planlagt ny veg mellom Vågsbotn og Nordhordland. Denne investeringa må vi forvalte til beste for Alver og innbyggarane.

Vi søker etter deg som er opptatt av å bruke planlegging som verktøy for samfunnsutvikling. Du må like å jobbe i skille mellom fag, politikk og administrasjon. 

I Alver kommune er vi eit dyktig team med stor arbeidsglede og høgt fagleg nivå.

Tenesteområdet plan- og utvikling har ansvar for samfunns- og arealplanlegging og analyser. Vi arbeider med kommuneplanen sin arealdel, områdeplanar, offentlege og private reguleringsplanar, moglegheitsstudiar og strategiar. Vi leverer kunnskapsgrunnlag til organisasjonen og prosjektstyrer overordna planarbeid i organisasjonen.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Arealplanlegging
  • Sakshandsaming av reguleringsplanar
  • Fremme saker til politisk behandling
  • Delta i annet relevant plan- og utredningsarbeid
  • Formidle planopplysningar og halde planregisteret oppdatert
Kvalifikasjonskrav 

Utdanning på masternivå som arkitekt, planleggar, geograf eller tilsvarande

Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for krav om utdanning på masternivå. Ønskelig med erfaring fra planlegging/saksbehandling av private planer.

Ønskt kompetanse

Vi søker deg som:

  • Trives og har erfaring med saksbehandling av reguleringsplaner
  • Ønskeleg med kompetanse innen naturmangfold og klima
  • Tar initiativ og kan drive saker fremover
  • Har evne til å raskt sette deg inn i nye problemstillinger
  • Er serviceinnstilt og kan ha ein god dialog med innbyggarar
  • Har god skriftleg og munnleg kommunikasjons- og formidlingsevne
  • Trivs med samarbeid, og vil vere ein god lagspelar for kollegaer
  • Personleg eignaheit vil bli vektlagt
  • Det er ønskeleg at du har førarkort klasse B
Me tilbyr
  • Eit tverrfagleg og godt arbeidsmiljø med høg kompetanse
  • Moglegheit for heimekontor etter gjeldande retningslinjer
  • Gode pensjon- og forsikringsordningar
  • Løn etter avtale
  • Varierte og utfordrande arbeidsoppgåver
  • God pensjonsordning i KLP
  • Tilsetjing i samsvar med gjeldande lov- og avtaleverk
Me er ein organisasjon i læring! 

Som ein del av arbeidet vert det forventa at du bidrar til ein læringskultur ved å dela kunnskap og utvikla deg i takt med endringar i samfunnet. Du heldt deg oppdatert på relevante arbeidsverktøy, arbeidsmetoder og aktivt tek ansvar for læring, samt fagleg og personleg utvikling. Vi arbeider med å utvikle vår digitale kompetanse, og nyttar mellom anna teams i vår informasjonsflyt. Bidrag til å løysa arbeidsoppgåver med ny teknologi eller anna vert godt motteke. 

Me er Alver

Me får vere der frå aller fyrste stund, og vi får følgje deg gjennom livet!

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_xHE9zF24G4&ab_channel=Alverkommune

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Alver kommune - Ein spennande organisasjon for engasjerte og kompetente medarbeidarar! 

Velkomen til Alver kommune, ein kommune som har vakse til å bli ein av dei største kommunane i fylket. Med om lag 30 000 innbyggjarar og 2 700 dedikerte tilsette, har vi eit sterkt samfunn som søkjer å løyse utfordringar og utvikle seg vidare. 

Vår plassering nord for Bergen gir oss privilegiet av ei variert og fascinerande natur. Frå rolege fjordar og opne havområde til majestetiske fjell og lokale toppar, byr Alver kommune på ei rekkje utandørs opplevingar. Vi er også stolte av å huse verdas beste korps og vere vertskap for eit rikt kulturliv. 

Vi verdset meiningsfulle oppgåver og ser på kvar einaste medarbeidar som ein verdifull bidragsytar til vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag. Som ein del av vårt team vil du få moglegheita til å engasjere deg og bruke din kompetanse til å forme framtida til vår kommune. Vi legg vekt på å skape eit arbeidsmiljø der du kan bløme og utvikle deg. Alver kommune har heiltidskultur som satsingsområde i heile organisasjonen.  

Bli med på vårt eventyr i Alver kommune, der vi søkjer etter dedikerte og dyktige menneske som ønsker å vere ein del av vår felles suksesshistorie. Vi ser fram til å ønskje deg velkommen og gi deg ei meiningsfull og givande karriere hos oss.

jobs.title: Director, Solution Consulting/FDE
jobs.description:
Director, Solution Consulting/FDE (AI & Enterprise Workflow Solutions)

 

➡️ Have you led and developed high-performing Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI?

➡️ Do you have the technical depth to go beyond traditional pre-sales, with hands-on experience in AI, APIs, integrations and workflow automation?

➡️ Want to lead a global function at the forefront of AI-powered innovation, helping some of the world's leading organisations transform how they approach R&D, Intellectual Property and technology development?

If this sounds like your next move, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

Patsnap is seeking a commercially minded, technically capable leader to manage and develop our global Solutions Consulting team, supporting all products supporting Patsnap's portfolio across Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, Materials Science and Engineering.

As we expand our AI capabilities, our approach to Solutions Consulting is evolving. Beyond traditional product demonstrations and technical evaluations, we're increasingly helping customers integrate Patsnap's intelligence, AI agents and data directly into their existing systems and business workflows.

You'll lead an established global team of Solutions Consultants, strengthening its technical capabilities and expanding the function through the introduction of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). This includes defining how the team approaches technical discovery, solution development and customer engagement, ensuring we're equipped to support increasingly complex enterprise requirements.

This role offers the opportunity to have a genuine impact on how we operate, how we support our customers and how we bring our next generation of AI capabilities to market.

We're looking for someone who brings substantial experience leading customer-facing technical teams, alongside the technical depth to challenge, guide and contribute to solution development. You'll be responsible for building a function that not only supports commercial growth, but plays an increasingly important role in how customers adopt and integrate Patsnap's technology into their operations.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid position based in our Farringdon office, with a requirement to work on-site at least one day per week, on Wednesdays.

 

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, pre-IPO technology company transforming how organisations use Intellectual Property and Research & Development intelligence to drive innovation.

Our AI-powered platform connects patent intelligence, scientific research, Life Sciences data and market insights, helping organisations make more informed decisions, accelerate R&D and bring new innovations to market.

Trusted by over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the world's leading innovators, we've raised $300 million in Series E funding, reaching a valuation of over $1 billion.

As we continue to evolve into an AI-native business, we're enabling customers to integrate our proprietary data, AI agents and intelligence directly into their existing technology and business processes.

With offices in Singapore, London, Toronto and Shanghai, alongside remote teams across the US, we're an international business with ambitious plans for continued growth. Our culture is high-performing but low ego, with a strong emphasis on collaboration, ownership and developing people.

What You'll Be Doing:

Global Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach and develop the global Solutions Consulting team, setting clear expectations for performance, customer impact and commercial contribution.

  • Recruit and integrate FDEs, combining consulting expertise, domain knowledge and practical technical delivery within one team.

  • Assess capability gaps and implement development plans covering AI workflows, MCPs, APIs, data handling, prototyping and solution design.

  • Establish practical standards for technical proficiency and ensure learning translates into demonstrated customer-facing capability.

  • Prioritise team resources across regions, verticals and commercial opportunities.

  • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Customer Engagement & Commercial Partnership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Account Management and Customer Success to support new business, expansion and customer adoption.

  • Lead discovery sessions that uncover customer priorities, workflows, technical requirements and desired business outcomes.

  • Oversee and participate in demonstrations, workshops, technical evaluations and enterprise solution discussions.

  • Translate complex product and data capabilities into clear customer value and compelling commercial propositions.

  • Establish clear scope, success criteria and timelines for proofs of concept (PoCs), aligning technical work with qualified commercial opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, domain practitioners and technical stakeholders.

AI, MCP & Data Solution Delivery

  • Lead by example in configuring and demonstrating practical solutions using Patsnap’s products, AI agents, MCPs, APIs and data.

  • Help customers incorporate Patsnap capabilities into their own AI environments and business processes.

  • Guide Solutions Consultants and FDEs in building rapid prototypes, testing workflows and validating customer value.

  • Ensure evaluations consider output quality, source traceability, data permissions, integration requirements and usage costs.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering to progress successful prototypes into supported solutions, with Engineering owning production architecture, security and platform development.

Product Collaboration & Scalable Solutions

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering and subject matter experts to translate customer needs into product improvements and repeatable solutions.

  • Create a clear process for sharing field feedback and progressing promising customer prototypes into product development.

  • Turn successful engagements into reusable Skills, connectors, workflow templates, demonstrations and implementation guidance.

  • Ensure the team can support the full portfolio, drawing on domain specialists where deeper expertise is required.

  • Contribute to commercial enablement through use cases, discovery frameworks, demo narratives and evidence of customer outcomes.

  • Identify recurring customer needs that create opportunities for differentiated data offerings, integrations and AI workflows.


What We'd Love From You:

We're looking for an experienced Solutions Consulting or Sales Engineering leader who has successfully developed customer-facing technical teams and understands how to build a function that contributes directly to enterprise commercial success. you'll bring the technical depth to engage meaningfully in solution design and AI development, alongside the leadership experience to build capability at scale.

Required Experience

  • Proven leadership experience: 5+ years leading Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering or comparable customer-facing technical teams within enterprise SaaS, data or AI.

  • Commercial impact: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, influencing technical buying decisions and connecting technical solutions to measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Technical credibility: Practical experience with APIs, data integrations, AI tools and workflow automation, with the ability to build, adapt or critically assess technical prototypes and demonstrations.

  • AI and agentic workflows: A working understanding of AI agents, MCP and how LLM-powered applications connect with external systems, tools and data.

  • Team development: Experience recruiting, coaching and developing technical talent, including improving the technical capabilities of an established team.

  • Enterprise customer engagement: Strong discovery, presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to engage senior business leaders and technical decision-makers.

  • Global and cross-functional leadership: Experience working across international teams and partnering with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering.

  • Strategic and commercial judgement: The ability to assess opportunity value, prioritise resources and balance technical delivery with wider commercial objectives.

Even Better If You Have:

  • Experience introducing Forward Deployed Engineering capabilities or evolving a traditional pre-sales function towards more advanced technical solution delivery.

  • Exposure to Intellectual Property, Life Sciences, R&D, Materials Science or innovation intelligence.

  • Experience using Python, JavaScript or low-code tools for prototyping, data manipulation and workflow automation.

  • Knowledge of enterprise AI adoption, including retrieval, AI agent evaluation and data governance.

  • Experience turning customer-specific technical solutions into reusable assets, integrations or scalable product capabilities.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, collaborative, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, or marital, veteran/military, or disability status, or any other protected status in accordance with federal, provincial/state or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Senior Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs and payment flows. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end: a risk-ranked backlog, remediation SLAs, an escalation path, and closing findings together with the teams.

  • Scope and coordinate the annual external penetration test and produce secure-development evidence for PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.


Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in Product/Application Security (or 3+ years and a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You have run threat modelling and secure design reviews on real systems (STRIDE or similar).

  • Hands-on with SAST/SCA/secrets scanning in CI (Aikido, Semgrep, Snyk or similar).

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

jobs.title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
jobs.description:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

jobs.title: Brannkonstabel m/ funksjon som L-1.4 - fast 2,42% (deltid) - Knarvik stasjon
jobs.description:
Om stillinga

Me har ledig ei fast stilling som brannkonstabel ved Knarvik stasjon. Stillinga har funksjon som tankbilsjåfør. Funksjonen kan bli endra dersom behova i organisasjonen endrar seg.

Stillinga inngår i ein vaktturnus med vakt kvar femte veke. Vaktperioden strekkjer seg frå kl. 15.30 til 08.00 på kvardagar, og frå fredag kl. 15.30 til måndag kl. 08.00 i helgene. Vaktplikta gjeld også på heilagdagar. Stillinga har ein storleik på 2,42%. 

Ein må pårekne arbeid utover dette, avhengig av oppdragsmengd

Om NHBR
  • Nordhordland brann og redning (NHBR) vart etablert i 2019, ved samanslåing av tre brannvesen. NHBR dekkjer kommunane Alver, Austrheim og Modalen, med Alver kommune som vertskommune. Ansvarsområdet dekkjer 1.149km2, med 34 000 innbyggjarar.  
  • Nordhordland brann og redning (NHBR) er organisert med tre einingar: Operativ, feiing og bustadtilsyn og førebyggjande eining.  
  • Operativ eining er fordelt på fem brannstasjonar - Knarvik, Lindås, Manger, Mastrevik og Modalen, og to depot på Kaland og Øvre Helland. Alle stasjonar er bemanna av brannkonstablar som jobbar deltid, og Knarvik har i tillegg dagkassernering.
Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Vere ein del av deltidsstyrken i NHBR, med fast vakt kvar 5. veke 
  • Operative oppgåver/utrykkingar 
  • Sjåfør på tankbil og røykdykkar
  • Systematisk øving og trening for å oppretthalde naudsynt ferdigeheitar og kompetanse
  • Bidra til vedlikehald av bilar og operativt utstyr 
  • Bidra til å utvikle og oppretthalde ein god organisasjonskultur og eit godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Andre oppgåver som naturleg fell inn under stillinga
Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Godkjendt røykdykkar
  • Fullført og bestått NHBR sitt interne aspirantkurs
  • Bestått fysisk test i samsvar med forskrift (årleg krav) 
  • Godkjent helsekontroll 
  • Politiattest - I tråd med brann- og eksplosjonsvernloven § 18 vert det stilt krav om uttømmande politiattest før tiltreding 
  • Bustad maks 10 minutt frå stasjonen 
  • Fysisk og psykisk skikka til stillinga
  • Førarkortklassar B, C og E-160 kompetansebevis for utrykkings køyring 

  • Mestre norsk munnleg og skriftleg 

     

  • Kandidatar med lengre avstand til stasjonen kan bli vurdert der det er moglegheit for intern rokkering av ressursar. Kandidatar som ikkje har E-160 kompetansebevis kan bli vurdert for stillinga.
Me tilbyr
  • Spennande og utfordrande arbeidsplass med samfunnsviktig funksjon
  • Lønn- og tilsetjngsforhold etter lov- og avtaleverk 
  • Tilsett kan også bli nytta i andre funksjonar (under føresetnad av nødvendig kompetanse/opplæring)
Politiattest 

I tråd med brann- og eksplosjonsvernlova § 18 vert det stilt krav om tilfredsstillande politiattest ved tiltrede

Våre forventningar til deg
  • Vi ser etter deg som er motivert, pålitelig og har god rolleforståing. 
  • Du opptrèr roleg i stressande situasjonar og har god evne til å prioritere. 
  • Har forståing for risiko ved køyring, samt behovet for vedlikehald av tungbil. 
  • Det er viktig for oss at du både arbeider godt sjølvstendig og er ein god og tillitsvekkjande lagspelar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordhordland brann og redning (NHBR) er eit felles brannvesen for 5 kommunar i Nordhordland. NHBR er organisert med tre avdelingar. Det er avdeling for feiing og bustadtilsyn, operativ avdeling og førebyggande avdeling. Førebyggjande avdeling har ansvar for 7 kommunar og heiter Nordhordland og Gulen Interkommunale brannførebyggjande avdeling (NGIB).Dette er eit samarbeidsprosjekt mellom kommunane Gulen, Austrheim, Modalen, Masfjorden, Fedje, Solund og Alver, der Alver er vertskommune for avdelinga. Avdelinga har 5 tilsette som dekkjer kommunane i samarbeidet.

jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare – elektronik och tekniska system
jobs.description: Här utvecklar du mjukvara för produkter som används i sin faktiska miljö, bara en trappa ner. Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan programmering, elektronik och hårdvara, där tekniska funktioner ska samverka i en komplett lösning. Korta beslutsvägar ger utrymme att påverka både detaljer och helhet, från idé till fungerande produkt.Om tjänstenDu blir del av ett utvecklingsteam som bygger och vidareutvecklar testsystem för avancerade elektronikkomponenter. Testutrustningen används nära produktionen, vilket innebär att du snabbt ser hur lösningarna fungerar i praktiken och kan utveckla dem utifrån nya behov.Du arbetar främst med mjukvaruutveckling i LabVIEW, men bygger och vidareutvecklar även hårdvara när systemen kräver det. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera programmering med praktisk teknisk problemlösning och följa resultatet hela vägen till användning.Om anställningenDetta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer till en början att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från vår kunds och vår sida är att du efter 12 månader blir direktanställd hos kunden.Övrig info    Omfattning: Heltid    Start: Enligt överenskommelse    Placering: Solna, Stockholm    Lön: Marknadsmässig månadslön    Kontaktperson: Anna PerssonOm FridayPå Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

jobs.title: (Junior-) IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder alter Hase: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du Technik verstehen willst, Verantwortung übernimmst und mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe sprichst. Was du noch nicht kannst, lernst du bei uns, mit Kollegen, die mit dir draufschauen, eigenem Lab und Budget für Zertifizierungen.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

  • Du betreust unsere Kundenumgebungen zentral, von Patching und Monitoring bis Endpoint-Security und Backup

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, wenn etwas hakt, vom kurzen Anruf bis zur kniffligen Störung, und dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt

  • Du redest bei Standards, Tooling und unseren Abläufen aktiv mit und automatisierst, was sich wiederholt

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, zum Beispiel als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder vergleichbare Praxis

  • Du verstehst, wie Netzwerke grundsätzlich funktionieren, und weißt, was Firewall, VPN und Routing tun

  • Firewalls und VPNs hast du schon selbst konfiguriert, nicht nur davon gehört

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein dicker Stapel Zertifikate. Wichtig ist, dass du sauber baust und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. Aktueller Stack, KI-gestütztes Arbeiten und kein Altlast-Ballast, der dich ausbremst.

Zertifizierungen auf uns. Wer sich bei unseren Herstellern zertifizieren will, bekommt Zeit und Budget dafür.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

Bildungsurlaub ist willkommen. Kein unangenehmes Gespräch, kein schlechtes Gewissen. Wer sich weiterbilden will, hat unsere volle Unterstützung.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Leben und Arbeit muss man manchmal jonglieren. Dafür hast du bei uns Verständnis und Spielraum.

Home-Office. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Home-Office in Absprache möglich.

Das sehen wir als Standard an

  • Ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz mit leistungsstarker Workstation

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

jobs.title: Kock till restaurang i Stockholm

jobs.title: Woonbegeleider -     Regio Gent
jobs.description:
Voor onze woonbegeleiding in de regio Gent zijn we op zoek naar nieuwe collega's! We bieden er woonondersteuning aan volwassenen met een beperking op twee verschillende sites: Het Zandeken in Mariakerke en De Wal in Wondelgem.

Je wordt voornamelijk toegewezen aan één van beide sites, maar we verwachten ook de nodige flexibiliteit om, wanneer nodig, bij te springen op de andere site.

Beide sites hebben hun eigen karakter, maar delen dezelfde warme en huiselijke aanpak, met aandacht voor kleinschaligheid, samenleven en verbondenheid met de buurt.

Op site Het Zandeken wonen volwassenen met een matig mentale, soms ook fysieke beperking. De site ligt in een rustige, groene omgeving in een woonwijk in Mariakerke. Een team van een 20-tal medewerkers en vrijwilligers staat in voor de begeleiding van een 30-tal bewoners.

Woonsite De Wal ligt in Wondelgem, aan het Vyncke-Bovynpark, midden in het groen en vlak bij het dagcentrum en Villa Ooievaar, ons sociaal restaurant. Vanuit twee woonhuizen bieden we residentiële woonondersteuning aan een 20-tal volwassenen met een matig mentale beperking.

Jouw rol en impact:

  • Je deelt dagelijkse dingen en betekenisvolle momenten met de bewoners, van een wandeling tot een verjaardagsfeest

  • Je switcht naargelang de noden tussen beide deelwerkingen (Mariakerke-Wondelgem)

  • Je begeleidt cliënten met zorg, respect en een gezonde dosis humor

  • Je werkt volgens individuele ondersteuningsplannen en zorgt mee voor een warme groepssfeer

  • Je bent tegelijk een luisterend oor, een structuurgever en een sparringpartner

  • Je denkt mee over activiteiten, routines en verbetering

  • Je hebt een hart voor de zorg ❤️‍🔥 We zoeken medewerkers met een groot engagement en een klein ego, we zoeken geen superhelden; wel warme, daadkrachtige mensen die iets willen betekenen in het leven van volwassenen met een beperking.

  • Je bent iemand die structuur en spontaniteit weet te combineren

  • Je hebt ervaring of een diploma in sociale wetenschappen (orthopedagogie(k), ergotherapie, jeugd- en gehandicaptenzorg, toegepaste psychologie, sociaal werk, persoonsbegeleider ..)

  • Je bent flexibel in mindset

  • Je bent een teamplayer met zin voor initiatief én een portie relativeringsvermogen

  • Je denkt vooruit en weet van aanpakken

  • Een rijbewijs B is een meerwaarde 🚗

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Kund- och Personalansvarig
jobs.description: Vill du ha ett arbete där ditt ledarskap faktiskt gör skillnad i människors vardag?Vi på Trygg Assistans söker nu en kund- och personalansvarig som vill vara med och skapa trygg, kvalitativ och personlig assistans – för både våra kunder och våra assistenter.Det här är en roll för dig som har erfarenhet, är trygg i att ta ansvar och inte backar när situationen kräver ett svårt beslut. Samtidigt är du en person som förstår att personlig assistans i grunden handlar om människor. Om livskvalitet, självständighet, trygghet och att få vardagen att fungera på ett bra sätt.Om rollenSom kund- och personalansvarig blir du en viktig länk mellan kunden, assistenterna och Trygg Assistans. Du ansvarar för att våra assistansuppdrag fungerar i vardagen och utvecklas över tid.Du kommer att ha ett övergripande ansvar för dina assistansgrupper och vara nära både kunder och medarbetare. Det innebär att du behöver kunna lyssna, bygga relationer och skapa förtroende – men också kunna kliva fram, fatta beslut och agera när det behövs.Du blir bland annat ansvarig för:- Personalplanering, bemanning och resursfördelning- Medarbetarsamtal, lönesamtal och utveckling av medarbetare- Arbetsmiljö och systematiskt arbetsmiljöarbete- Utbildning och kompetensutveckling för assistenter-Uppföljning av genomförandeplaner och dokumentation- Kontakt och uppföljning med kunder- Samordning vid nya assistansuppdrag- Att assistansen bedrivs enligt LSS, arbetsmiljölagstiftning, kollektivavtal och övriga aktuella regler- Samarbete med verksamhetschef, kollegor, myndigheter och andra samarbetspartners- Tjänsten innebär även jourtelefon enligt schema på morgnar, kvällar, helger och röda dagar.Vem söker vi?Vi söker framför allt rätt person.Du behöver vara trygg i dig själv, ha gott omdöme och kunna hantera situationer där det inte alltid finns ett enkelt svar. Du ska kunna stå kvar när det blåser, fatta beslut när det behövs och samtidigt ha förmågan att se människan bakom situationen.Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av personlig assistans, arbetsledning, personalansvar eller liknande arbete. Du kan också ha en längre erfarenhet inom vård och omsorg där du haft ansvar, lett andra eller arbetat i situationer som krävt stort eget omdöme.Det viktigaste är inte exakt vilken titel du haft tidigare – utan vad du har med dig för erfarenhet och vem du är som person.Vi tror att du:- Är trygg i att ta ansvar och fatta beslut- Har erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna personal- Har lätt för att skapa förtroende och goda relationer- Kan vara både lyhörd och tydlig- Har förståelse för arbetsmiljö och personalfrågor- Kan hantera konflikter och svåra samtal på ett professionellt sätt- Är strukturerad och kan hålla flera saker igång samtidigt- Förstår vikten av att följa lagar, regler och rutiner- Har ett genuint intresse för människor och personlig assistans- Vågar agera när något behöver förändras- Personlig lämplighet kommer att väga tungt i vår bedömning.Det här är det viktigaPersonlig assistans är ett arbete med stort ansvar. Men det är också ett arbete där man varje dag får möjlighet att göra konkret skillnad för en annan människa.Som kund- och personalansvarig behöver du kunna hålla två perspektiv samtidigt:- Kunden ska få leva ett så självständigt, tryggt och rikt liv som möjligt.- Assistenterna ska ha en hållbar arbetsmiljö, känna sig sedda och ha rätt förutsättningar att göra ett bra arbete.När de delarna fungerar tillsammans skapar vi bra assistans. Det är det vi vill att du ska vara med och bygga.Vi erbjuderHos oss får du en betydelsefull roll i en verksamhet där det du gör märks. Du får stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka hur assistansen fungerar för både kunder och medarbetare.Vi tror på ett nära samarbete, tydlig kommunikation och på att lösa saker tillsammans. Samtidigt behöver du trivas med att självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt.När börjar du?Vi ser gärna att vår nya kund- och personalansvariga kan börja så snart som möjligt.Vi har ingen brådska att hitta vem som helst. För oss är det viktigare att hitta rätt person.Känner du igen dig i beskrivningen och tror att du skulle passa hos oss? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.Välkommen med din ansökan till Trygg Assistans.Om oss Trygg Assistans är ett litet och familjärt företag med kunden och dennes assistenter i fokus. Vi tillämpar kollektivavtal och erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag. Varje grupp har en egen kund-och personalansvarig som ser till att du trivs och får den hjälp du behöver för att lyckas i ditt arbete. Hos oss känner vi varandra – här är ingen anonym. Eftersom vi känner våra kunder väl, sköter vi vår egen rekrytering. Därför undanber vi oss vänligen men bestämt all kontakt från rekrytering-och bemanningsföretag.

jobs.title: Funksjonshemmet kvinne søker BPA assistenter!
jobs.description:
Liker du å hjelpe andre og skape gode opplevelser? Som BPA-assistent hos meg får du en meningsfull jobb der du bidrar til at jeg kan leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.

Vi søker assistenter til stillinger både på ettermiddag/helg og hvilende nattevakter, og vi ønsker at du spesifiserer i søknaden din hvilken av stillingene du søker på. For tiden har vi størst behov for assistenter på ettermiddag og i helger.

Jeg er en kvinne som bor i egen leilighet i Fana bydel. Hverdagen min er aktiv og innholdsrik – jeg har dagtilbud fem dager i uken og deltar på ulike aktiviteter på fritiden. Nå søker jeg flere BPA-assistenter som kan bli en del av mitt team, som kan bistå slik at jeg kan leve livet etter mine behov.

  • Er pålitelig, punktlig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Er selvstendig, med evne til å se hva som må gjøres
  • Har gode norskferdigheter, og kommunikasjonsevner
  • Har erfaring fra lignende arbeid (ikke et krav, men et pluss)

  • Enkelt husarbeid

Vi har for tiden flere ledige stillinger, som for tiden er organisert i en 12 ukers turnus.

  • Faste stillinger organisert på ettermiddag/kveld/ helg ( fra 30 til 50%, med mulighet for økning)

Arbeidstider:

  • Hvilende nattevakt: 2145-0830

I helgene varieres det mellom dagvakter og ettermiddag/kveldsvakter annenhver arbeidshelg.

Har du spørsmål om stillingen: Kontakt arbeidsleder Vigdis Søvik: vigdisanne@online.no

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med utviklingsmuligheter
  • Ryddige arbeidsforhold med forsikring og pensjon
  • Enkle, digitale systemer for vaktplan og timeføring
  • Gode ansattfordeler, som rabattert trening på SATS

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

jobs.title: GxP Computerised Systems Validation Consultant
jobs.description:
About Intelance

Intelance is an independent technology, AI and cyber assurance firm based in the UK. We help organisations check, govern and improve their technology through enterprise architecture, AI governance, cyber assurance and data governance work. We are building a small panel of senior associates to deliver technology and AI due diligence on company sales and investments.

The role

You will check whether software used in drug development is validated to GxP standards, as part of technology due diligence for clients who are selling, buying or investing in life sciences technology companies. Pharmaceutical buyers want proof that a platform producing trial and regulatory outputs works reliably, keeps a full audit trail and would stand up to an inspection.

You report to an Intelance engagement partner and work alongside our pharma specialist and technology due diligence lead, who bring your findings into the final report.

What you will do

  • Review the validation approach, records and evidence for platforms that produce clinical trial and real world evidence outputs.

  • Check audit trails, access controls, electronic records and change control against 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Judge whether the validation is proportionate to risk, using GAMP 5 and Computer Software Assurance thinking.

  • Check how validation is kept current when AI workflows and machine learning models change.

  • Check that outputs follow the expected data standards, such as CDISC SDTM and ADaM.

  • Rate each finding by how it could affect the deal, and write clear, practical fixes.

What you will bring

  • At least five years of computerised system validation in a GxP setting.

  • Hands on use of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.

  • Experience validating or auditing systems that produce clinical trial or regulatory submission outputs.

  • Working knowledge of CDISC data standards.

  • Clear, plain writing that founders, buyers and lawyers can follow.

  • Experience validating systems that use machine learning or AI is a strong plus.

How the work is set up

  • Remote within the UK, with occasional meetings in London.

  • Around 3 to 5 days between late November 2026 and the end of January 2027, with further engagements as the practice grows.
