jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Financial Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.


You will:

 - Set technical direction for Replit’s financial infrastructure, with an immediate focus on enterprise billing, spend controls, and financial correctness.

 - Build shared services for usage-based billing, pricing, credits, subscriptions, and entitlements so product teams can launch without rebuilding billing.

 - Automate enterprise contract lifecycles—from onboarding through amendments and renewals—keeping commercial terms, provisioned credits, and invoices in sync.

 - Build timely budget enforcement, alerts, and overrides that give customers control over spend without disrupting their hosted apps.

 - Make AI usage understandable: attribute costs to the right customer, workspace, user, or agent, including delegated work without double-counting.

 - Build reconciliation and audit trails that make balances and invoices explainable and help Finance catch discrepancies before customers do.

 - Simplify the billing stack through safe migrations that preserve balances, transaction history, and customer access.

 - Own production reliability through testing, observability, incident response, and safe recovery from duplicate events, delayed usage, and partial failures.

 - Stay hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Support.


Required skills and experience:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical ownership: setting architecture and delivering complex initiatives across teams.

 - Deep experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, databases, and event-driven architecture.

 - Sound judgment around transactions, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

 - Experience evolving live systems and migrating data without compromising correctness or availability.

 - Product judgment that balances customer needs, delivery speed, and long-term system quality.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, including translating business requirements into system behavior.

 - Hands-on leadership through implementation, design reviews, mentoring, and production ownership.


Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, credits, entitlements, or other financial systems.

 - Experience with enterprise contracts, negotiated pricing, invoicing, or quote-to-cash automation.

 - Experience with high-volume usage metering, pricing calculations, or low-latency spend controls.

 - Experience building reconciliation, financial reporting, or auditable transaction histories with Finance and Accounting.

 - Experience integrating billing, payment, or CRM platforms, with judgment about what to build versus buy.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with AI or cloud infrastructure billing, including variable costs and attribution across distributed workloads.

 - Experience building customer-facing spend visibility, budgets, or internal tools that reduce manual billing work.

 - Experience with cloud marketplace billing, payment recovery, or fraud and dispute workflows.

 - Familiarity with agentic commerce or delegated spending. These are additional strengths, not requirements.



What we value:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements.

 - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout.

 - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions.

 - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients.

 - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.

 - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness.

 - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck.

 - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams.

 - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically.

Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer NDA
jobs.description:
GT was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive.Â GTâs mission is to connect the worldâs best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands.

On behalf of the client, GT is looking for a Senior Agentic AI Engineer who is interested in solving complex matching and search problems at scale, applying ML and algorithms to hundreds of millions of real-world data records.

Â 

About the Client

Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact.

Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale.

Â 

About the Project & Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights.

  • Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework, including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Core Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering.

  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

jobs.description:
CNC Machinist – Advanced Turning of Stainless Steel

No application or CV required - Danish optional!

Would you like to work with complex components, modern Okuma machines and a high degree of freedom in your daily work?

At MC Uldall Maskinfabrik, we are looking for a skilled CNC machinist to join our turning department in Skanderborg, Denmark.

We manufacture high-precision components for industries including food processing, pharmaceuticals and offshore. Our customers have high expectations when it comes to quality, documentation and surface finish. We are therefore looking for a colleague who takes pride in their craftsmanship and enjoys finding the right technical solutions.

What we offer

  • A strong team of experienced CNC machinists and machine operators

  • Modern Okuma machines and exciting technical challenges

  • Flexible working hours, with start times between 5:30 and 8:00 a.m.

  • Opportunities for professional development and responsibility

  • A flat organisational structure where your ideas are heard

  • A financially sound and growing company

  • A good canteen arrangement and a great team atmosphere

Your responsibilities

You will be working with:

  • Setting up and machining stainless steel components

  • Programming and optimisation using IGF and Mastercam

  • Operating Okuma LB4000EX II, LT200MY and Multus U4000 machines

  • Ongoing quality control and documentation

  • Optimising machining processes and cycle times

We work with both one-off and small-batch production, offering a varied working day with a wide range of components and technical challenges.

What we expect from you

  • You are a qualified CNC machinist, industrial technician or have equivalent qualifications

  • You have experience in CNC turning

  • Experience with Okuma machines and/or Mastercam is an advantage

  • You work independently and take responsibility for quality

  • You are organised and contribute to a positive team environment within the department

Above all, what matters is that you want to be part of the team and are passionate about your trade.

Who is MC Uldall?

MC Uldall Maskinfabrik A/S is a modern subcontract manufacturing company with more than 50 employees based in Skanderborg, Denmark. We specialise in machining and welding stainless steel and supply components to some of Northern Europe's most demanding industries.

We combine a high level of technical expertise with a down-to-earth culture where we support one another and take good care of our employees.

How to apply

Neither an application nor a CV is required. Save yourself the time and simply answer a few questions, and we will get in touch for an informal conversation.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact:

Casper L. Rosvall, CTO, +45 23 44 76 67

Even if you call us, please remember to provide your contact details as well.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  #LI-CL1

jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Solutions

You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work!At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.Joining Alfa Laval means being part of a flat, open, and inclusive culture that values collaboration and empowers employees. jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.description:
About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

Department: Talgo Warranty / Logistics & Warehouse Operations

Position Summary: The Warehouse Specialist is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, movement, control, and distribution of materials supporting Talgo warranty operations. The role ensures stock accuracy, timely material availability, safe warehouse practices, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Update and consult information related to incoming and outgoing materials using the designated software application (SW tool).

  • Analyze, plan, and organize material flow and delivery to assembly workstations in coordination with senior management.

  • Monitor and follow up on internally manufactured materials throughout the production flow while maintaining effective communication with all involved departments.

  • Ensure proper management and replenishment of all KANBAN materials.

  • Detect data discrepancies and report errors or inconsistencies to senior management.

  • Move materials using appropriate lifting, handling, and internal transportation equipment.

  • Conduct inventory counts and support stock accuracy initiatives.

  • Follow up and claim required materials from procurement, purchasing, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders, providing status updates to management.

  • Manage warehouse stock including receiving, storing, counting goods, monitoring shelf life where applicable, and handling expired or rejected items.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers, ensuring smooth communication and service levels.

  • Operate outdoor vehicles such as vans, trucks, and cars to support operational requirements and resolve logistics issues.

  • Ensure correct receipt, storage, distribution, and internal logistics operations to provide workstations with required materials on time.

  • Pack and palletize all incoming and outgoing materials in accordance with company procedures, quality requirements, and safety guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience in warehouse, logistics, material control, or a similar role.

  • Ability to use warehouse management and inventory software systems.

  • Knowledge of stock control, inventory management, and material handling processes.

  • Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work safely, accurately, and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good teamwork and problem-solving capabilities.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

jobs.title: Anaesthetic Nurse Wanted – Anaesthesia Unit 1
jobs.description:
Are you looking for new challenges? Would you like to work alongside skilled colleagues in an educational and dynamic environment where professional excellence and high-quality patient care are top priorities?You can expect a varied, fast-paced and sometimes unpredictable working day, with plenty of responsibility. In return, we promise you a workplace characterised by high job satisfaction and a strong sense of teamwork, where there is always room for humour and a smile, no matter how busy things get.About Anaesthesia Unit 1The unit covers several specialties and operates across two hospital sites. You will primarily be based at the new Hospital City East (Hospitalsbyen Øst), with only occasional shifts at Aalborg South. This advertisement describes the position within Anaesthesia Unit 1 East, which will be your primary place of employment.We bring together two specialties in a combined orthopaedic and neurosurgical anaesthesia unit.Neurosurgical anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for:
  • Intracranial surgery
  • Conventional spinal and neurosurgery
  • Surgery involving pain stimulation electrodes
Orthopaedic anaesthesiaWe provide anaesthesia for both children and adults across all orthopaedic subspecialties, covering everything from day surgery to major spinal surgery.In addition, our responsibilities include:

jobs.title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
jobs.description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. jobs.description: TULE SAHRAN TIIMIIN!Etsitkö työtä, jossa et ole vain numero muiden joukossa, vaan osa huipputiimiä? Sahran Sosiaalipalvelut etsii nyt uutta työkaveria kotihoidon tiimiin Pirhan alueelle!Etsimme sinua, jolla on jo kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveysalan asiakastyöstä ja sydän mukana tekemisessä! Olitpa sitten lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja tai sosionomi, saatat hyvinkin olla juuri etsimämme tyyppi.Erityisesti etsimme ammattilaista, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vammais-, kehitysvamma- ja/tai mielenterveysalan asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä. Arvostamme osaamistasi, mutta meille on yhtä tärkeää, millaisella asenteella kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit.Mitä me odotamme sinulta?Ammattitaito hallussa: Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva sosiaali- tai terveysalan tutkinto. Lääkehoidon laajat luvat, ensiaputaidot ja hygieniapassi kuuluvat osaamiseesi.Edellytämme sinulta hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.Kokemusta erityistä tukea tarvitsevien asiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä: Vammais-, kehitysvamma- ja/tai mielenterveysalan asiakastyö on sinulle jo tuttua. Osaat kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä yksilöllisesti ja ymmärrät, että jokainen asiakas tarvitsee omanlaisensa lähestymistavan.Ajokortti tulee löytyä taskusta, sillä työtehtävät edellyttävät liikkumista paikasta toiseen. Omaa autoa et kuitenkaan tarvitse, sillä menopeli löytyy talon puolesta.Ratkaisukeskeinen asenne: Joskus arki heittää eteen mutkia, mutta sinä et hätkähdä, vaan keksit ratkaisun hymyssä suin.Tiimihenkeä: Olet loistava tyyppi, jonka kanssa muiden on kiva tehdä töitä. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, mutta tiedät myös, että parhaat onnistumiset syntyvät yhdessä.Miksi Sahralla on kivempaa?Meillä et ole yksin. Tarjoamme joustavan työn, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan asiakkaiden arkeen. Meillä nauru saa kuulua, omia ideoita saa tuoda esiin ja apua saa aina pyytää.Arvostamme ammattitaitoasi, luotamme osaamiseesi ja haluamme, että viihdyt työssäsi. jobs.title: Produktionslederassistent søges til fast aftenhold i Give
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring fra produktion, og trives du med at tage ansvar, skabe overblik og sikre, at hverdagen fungerer? Så har vi en spændende mulighed for dig som produktionslederassistent på aftenhold i Give.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst produktionslederassistent (PLA) til en moderne fødevarevirksomhed i Give, som er i rivende vækst. Her får du en alsidig stilling, hvor du både bliver en aktiv del af den daglige produktion og samtidig får en vigtig rolle i at sikre struktur, samarbejde og en stabil drift på produktionslinjen.

Stillingen er oplagt til dig, der allerede har erfaring fra produktionsmiljøet og gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere. Måske har du tidligere haft en koordinerende rolle eller fungeret som mellemleder, eller måske er du den kollega, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper med at holde styr på opgaverne, når der er travlt.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor der er fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og godt samarbejde, og hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.

Om jobbet:

Som produktionslederassistent får du en vigtig funktion i den daglige drift på aftenholdet. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med dine kolleger i produktionen, hvor du både deltager i de praktiske arbejdsopgaver og hjælper med at koordinere arbejdet, så produktionslinjen kører effektivt.

En stor del af din hverdag vil foregå i produktionen, hvor du blandt andet skal betjene og overvåge produktionsmaskiner samt sikre, at arbejdet bliver udført i overensstemmelse med virksomhedens krav til kvalitet, hygiejne og orden.

Samtidig bliver du en vigtig støtte for dine kolleger. Du skal være med til at skabe overblik over dagens opgaver, hjælpe med at fordele arbejdet og tage initiativ, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs. Det kræver, at du kan bevare roen, træffe beslutninger og være med til at sikre en god arbejdsrytme på holdet.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Deltagelse i den daglige produktion samt betjening og overvågning af produktionsmaskiner

  • Koordinering af opgaver og understøttelse af en stabil drift på produktionslinjen

  • Opfølgning på kvalitet, hygiejne og orden i produktionen

  • Støtte og vejledning af kolleger i det daglige arbejde

  • Håndtering af udfordringer og sikring af et effektivt produktionsflow

Du får dermed en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du både kan bruge dine praktiske erfaringer og udvikle dine evner inden for koordinering og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra produktion og er vant til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, kvalitet og samarbejde er afgørende for, at opgaverne bliver løst. Har du tidligere arbejdet inden for fødevareproduktion, er det en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at tage ansvar.

Du er typen, der naturligt tager initiativ og hjælper til, hvor der er behov for det. Du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men trives også med at være en del af et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Det er vigtigt, at du er god til at bevare overblikket, også når der er mange opgaver i gang på samme tid. Du arbejder struktureret, er løsningsorienteret og har forståelse for, hvordan man skaber en effektiv hverdag i produktionen.

Har du tidligere haft en rolle som teamleder, produktionskoordinator eller mellemleder, vil det være et stort plus. Det er dog ikke et krav, så længe du har lysten og evnerne til at påtage dig en koordinerende funktion.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra produktion, gerne inden for fødevareindustrien

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og engageret

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe beslutninger i en travl hverdag

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og god til at motivere og hjælpe dine kolleger

  • Trives med både praktiske opgaver og koordinering af personale

  • Taler og skriver dansk

Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?

Du får mulighed for at blive en del af en moderne fødevarevirksomhed, der er i positiv udvikling, og hvor der er gode muligheder for at vokse med opgaverne.

Her bliver du en del af et produktionsmiljø, hvor du får ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift. Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og koordinerende opgaver, hvor din indsats har direkte betydning for, at produktionen fungerer optimalt.

Stillingen tilbydes som et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på efterfølgende fastansættelse. Det giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at lære hinanden godt at kende, inden en fast ansættelse.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fast aftenhold i en fuldtidsstilling

  • Try & Hire-forløb med mulighed for fastansættelse

  • En spændende rolle med ansvar i den daglige produktion

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde

  • En arbejdsplads i rivende vækst

Arbejdstider:

Stillingen er på fast aftenhold.

Arbejdssted: Give

Er du vores nye produktionslederassistent?

Har du erfaring fra produktion, og er du klar til en hverdag, hvor du både får mulighed for at arbejde praktisk og tage mere ansvar? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV til mo@teamly.dk, og skriv "PLA" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send gerne dit CV allerede i dag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Sales development Rep
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated full-time sales professional to join our commercial team. In this role, you will work with the CamReach platform, run outbound campaigns, follow up with prospects by phone, and support the development of our commercial pipeline.

This is a hands-on B2B sales role with a strong focus on outbound calling, but you will not be working alone. You will have a support structure around you with pre-sales research, target selection, prospect data, campaign messaging, and the CamReach platform helping you prepare for and follow up each conversation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound cold calls to selected Nordic SMB prospects based on structured pre-sales research and qualification

  • Follow up on prospects already engaged through CamReach campaigns across email and LinkedIn

  • Work from prepared target lists, company research, contact data, campaign messaging, and call support provided by the wider sales operation

  • Use the CamReach platform to understand prospect activity, engagement, and relevant context before and after calls

  • Qualify interest, identify sales opportunities, and move relevant prospects into the next stage of the sales process

  • Maintain accurate CRM and campaign records, including call outcomes, follow-up actions, and prospect feedback

  • Work closely with the sales team to continuously improve targeting, messaging, call scripts, and campaign performance

Mindset & Work Style

  • Self-managed and target-driven, and comfortable taking responsibility for your own activity and results

  • Comfortable working in an early-stage company where processes continue to evolve

  • Confident speaking with new prospects and starting commercial conversations

  • Professional and comfortable using LinkedIn as part of the sales process

  • Commercially minded and interested in understanding how different businesses sell and acquire customers

  • Willing to learn, test different approaches, and use feedback to improve

Skills

  • Fluency in Norwegian or one of the Scandinavian languages is a must

  • Strong verbal communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • Ability to independently research, understand, and qualify prospects

  • Ability to communicate clearly and adapt your approach to different companies and decision-makers

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, sales platforms, and digital tools

  • Confident handling objections and progressing conversations towards a meeting or next step

  • Ability to make cold calls

Experience

  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, or a similar commercial role

  • Experience with outbound calling and prospecting

  • Experience with cold outreach across channels such as phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • A track record of working towards activity, pipeline, or sales targets

Perks and benefits

  • Full-time position

  • Flexible working hours

  • Remote work allowed with prior coordination

  • Office location near public transport

  • Opportunity to grow with an early-stage technology company and take on increasing responsibility as the team expands

Working at CamReach AS

CamReach is a B2B sales platform built around three core capabilities: Discover. Qualify. Engage.

The platform helps companies identify the right prospects, qualify which opportunities are worth pursuing, and engage them through coordinated outreach across channels such as email and LinkedIn. The aim is to give sales teams a more structured and effective way to build pipeline, with better data, better preparation, and more relevant outreach.

CamReach comes from a strong software development and technology background. The platform has been developed by a team of experienced developers, data analysts, and data scientists with deep experience in building digital products, data-driven systems, and business applications.

The wider team combines this technical capability with senior commercial and executive experience across technology, international business development, sales, and company building. This means we approach the product from both sides: how the technology should work, and how it needs to perform in a real commercial environment.

We are an early-stage Norwegian technology company with paying customers and an active commercial pipeline. We also have an ambitious product and growth roadmap ahead of us, with plans to expand both the capabilities of the platform and the markets we serve.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join at an early stage, grow with the team, take on increasing responsibility, and be part of building the commercial side of a technology company with significant ambitions for the years ahead.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

CamReach is a B2B outbound sales platform built for Nordic and European SMBs. We help sales teams find the right prospects, run multichannel outreach across email and LinkedIn, and book more meetings, without adding headcount or relying on expensive agencies. The platform is built around a simple idea: precision beats volume. Instead of blasting thousands of generic messages, CamReach helps companies identify the right targets, craft relevant outreach, and learn from every campaign to get sharper over time. We are an early-stage Norwegian startup with paying customers, an active pipeline, and a team that moves fast. GDPR compliance is built into the core of what we do, which matters increasingly for companies selling into European markets. We are now expanding our go-to-market engine and looking for driven people to join the team.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

jobs.title: Er du en erfaren tungbilmekaniker? Ta neste steg som teknisk leder!
jobs.employer: TIP TRAILER SERVICES NORWAY ANS AVD BRYNE
jobs.description:
Er du en erfaren og kvalifisert mekaniker innen tunge kjøretøy som ønsker å ta neste steg i karrieren? TIP Trailer Services søker deg som ønsker å utvikle deg til teknisk leder ved vårt verksted i Norge!

Har du fagbrev og solid erfaring med tunge kjøretøy, men mangler enkelte kurs eller godkjenninger for å kunne påta deg et større teknisk ansvar? Da kan dette være muligheten du har ventet på!

Hos TIP Trailer Services får du kombinere praktisk verkstedarbeid med muligheten til å utvikle deg mot en ansvarsfull teknisk stilling i Norge.

Du trenger ikke å ha alle kurs og godkjenninger på plass fra første arbeidsdag. Har du riktig fagkompetanse, relevant erfaring og motivasjon, legger vi til rette for nødvendig videreutdanning og kompetanseheving.

Om stillingen

Vi søker en kvalifisert mekaniker med erfaring fra tunge kjøretøy, som har forutsetninger for på sikt å kunne ta rollen som teknisk leder ved vårt norske verksted.

Dette er først og fremst en praktisk stilling hvor du arbeider med service, vedlikehold, feilsøking og reparasjoner av lastebiler, trailere og tilhengere.

I tillegg til det praktiske arbeidet vil du få muligheten til å utvikle deg mot et større ansvar for verkstedets tekniske drift, og ved behov fungere som stedfortredende teknisk leder når nødvendige norske kvalifikasjoner og godkjenninger er på plass.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver
  • Service, vedlikehold og reparasjon av lastebiler, trailere og tilhengere
  • Feilsøking og diagnostisering av moderne tunge kjøretøy
  • Mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske reparasjoner
  • Periodisk kjøretøykontroll (EU-kontroll), forutsatt nødvendig godkjenning
  • Kontroll og utbedring av tekniske feil og mangler
  • Dokumentasjon og kvalitetssikring av utført arbeid
  • Teknisk problemløsning og støtte til kolleger
  • Bidra til en effektiv, sikker og velfungerende verksteddrift
  • På sikt påta deg et større teknisk ansvar og fungere som stedfortreder ved behov

Noe vaktordning kan forekomme.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har solid teknisk bakgrunn, stor interesse for mekanikk og ambisjoner om å utvikle deg videre innen faget.

Vi ønsker at du:

  • Har fagbrev, relevant mekanikerutdanning eller tilsvarende dokumentert kompetanse
  • Har erfaring med lastebiler, trailere, tilhengere eller andre tunge kjøretøy
  • Har god teknisk og mekanisk forståelse
  • Har forutsetninger for å oppfylle de norske kompetansekravene til en stilling som teknisk leder
  • Er løsningsorientert og trives med tekniske utfordringer
  • Arbeider selvstendig, strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Er ansvarsbevisst og opptatt av kvalitet
  • Trives med samarbeid og å støtte kollegene dine
  • Behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig, eller har gode forutsetninger for å arbeide på norsk
  • Gjerne har førerkort klasse C/CE, men dette er ikke et krav

Mangler du førerkort klasse C/CE eller enkelte nødvendige kurs?

For den rette kandidaten legger vi til rette for nødvendig opplæring og kompetanseutvikling gjennom arbeidet.

Hvorfor velge TIP Trailer Services?

TIP Trailer Services er en av Europas ledende aktører innen utleie, leasing, service og vedlikehold av transportutstyr.

Hos oss blir du en del av et internasjonalt selskap hvor teknisk kompetanse, sikkerhet og kvalitet står i sentrum.

Vi verdsetter våre medarbeideres erfaring og engasjement, og tilbyr en arbeidsplass hvor du får muligheten til å utvikle deg, ta ansvar og bygge en langsiktig karriere.

Hva tilbyr vi?
  • Fast og trygg ansettelse i Norge hos et internasjonalt selskap
  • Mulighet til å utvikle deg til teknisk leder
  • Nødvendig videreutdanning og relevante kurs for den rette kandidaten
  • En variert og praktisk arbeidshverdag med spennende tekniske utfordringer
  • Et positivt arbeidsmiljø med dyktige og hjelpsomme kolleger
  • Ordinær arbeidstid kl. 07.00–15.00, med noe vaktordning
  • Pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Helseforsikring
  • Globalt støtteprogram for ansatte
  • Bonus basert på ansettelsestid
  • Frukt på arbeidsplassen
Er du klar for neste steg i karrieren?

Du trenger ikke å jobbe som teknisk leder i dag. Det viktigste er at du har riktig erfaring, fagkompetanse og vilje til å utvikle deg.

Hos TIP Trailer Services får du muligheten til å bruke erfaringen din, videreutvikle kompetansen din og på sikt påta deg et større teknisk ansvar i vår norske verkstedvirksomhet.

Høres dette interessant ut? Vi forteller deg gjerne mer om stillingen og hvilke muligheter som finnes!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

TIP Trailer Services er en av Europas ledende leverandører av tjenester og løsninger innen transport- og logistikkbransjen. Med over 55 års erfaring tilbyr selskapet utleie, leasing, service, vedlikehold og reparasjon av tilhengere og annet transportutstyr.

Gjennom et omfattende europeisk nettverk av verksteder og serviceanlegg hjelper TIP Trailer Services transportbedrifter med å sikre effektiv, trygg og pålitelig kjøretøydrift.

Selskapet kombinerer solid bransjeerfaring med moderne teknologi og høy teknisk kompetanse. Med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhet, bærekraft og langsiktige kunderelasjoner er TIP Trailer Services en viktig samarbeidspartner for transportbedrifter over hele Europa.

jobs.title: Enhetschef (familjeledighetsvikariat)
jobs.description: **VI SÖKER EN ENHETSCHEF!****– Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för barn, unga och familjer?**Luna Familjecenter söker en engagerad och ansvarstagande **enhetschef till vår verksamhet för periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS) och övriga öppenvårdstjänster**.Tjänsten är ett **familjeledighetsvikariat på ett år**, från och med 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse, med möjlighet till förlängning.Vi söker dig som trivs med att leda och utveckla verksamhet, skapa struktur och arbeta nära både personal, klienter och samarbetsparter.**Om vår verksamhet**Luna Familjecenter erbjuder mångsidiga socialvårdstjänster för barn, unga och familjer. Vårt arbete präglas av ett systemiskt förhållningssätt där vi ser till barnets och familjens hela livssituation, med fokus på delaktighet, trygghet och individuella behov.**Periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS)** är en av våra öppenvårdstjänster och bedrivs vid vår enhet **Tomtebo i centrala Jakobstad**.Verksamheten erbjuder planerade stöddygn där barn och unga får vistas och övernatta i en trygg och hemlik miljö med stöd av professionell personal. Stöddygnen utformas individuellt utifrån barnets och familjens behov och målsättningar.Syftet är att stöda barnets välbefinnande, utveckling och vardagsfärdigheter samt bidra till att stärka familjens resurser och fungerande vardag. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med barnets vårdnadshavare och ansvariga sociala myndigheter.Barn och unga som får stöddygn kan även ha andra öppenvårdsinsatser, såsom stödperson eller familjearbete. När dessa insatser är knutna till stöddygnen ansvarar enhetschefen även för att koordinera och samordna uppdragen, så att stödet bildar en fungerande helhet utifrån barnets och familjens behov.**Om tjänsten**Som enhetschef har du ett övergripande ansvar för verksamhetens personal, dagliga arbete och klientprocesser.**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**- Leda, stöda och utveckla personalgruppen samt ansvara för personalfrågor. - Ansvara för planering, genomförande, uppföljning och utvärdering av klienternas individuella stödinsatser. - Planera och samordna verksamhetens resurser och bemanning. - Säkerställa ett gott samarbete med sociala myndigheter, vårdnadshavare och övriga samarbetsparter. - Ansvara för verksamhetens kvalitet, struktur och kontinuerliga utveckling. - Ingå i Luna Familjecenters ledningsgrupp och aktivt bidra till utvecklingen av hela organisationens verksamhet. **Behörighetskrav**För tjänsten förutsätts:- **Lämplig utbildning inom social- eller hälsovårdsbranschen**, exempelvis socionom (YH), sjukskötare (YH) eller socialarbetare, samt registrering som yrkesutbildad person inom social- eller hälsovården. - **Erfarenhet av ledarskap alternativt fortbildning inom ledarskap.** - **Kännedom om socialvård och/eller barnskydd.** - **Goda kunskaper i både svenska och finska**, såväl muntligt som skriftligt. **Som merit ses utbildning inom eller kunskap om systemiskt arbetssätt.****Vem söker vi?**Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och ansvarstagande person med ett genuint intresse för arbete med barn, unga och familjer.Vi värdesätter att du:- Har god organisationsförmåga och kan planera, prioritera och skapa struktur. - Har ett närvarande och inkluderande ledarskap där du kan stöda, motivera och utveckla medarbetarna. - Är självständig och lösningsfokuserad samt trygg i att fatta beslut. - Har god samarbetsförmåga och lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer. - Har intresse för kvalitetsarbete och verksamhetsutveckling. **Vad erbjuder vi?**Hos Luna Familjecenter blir du en del av en **välmående, positiv och engagerad arbetsgemenskap** där samarbete, delaktighet och utveckling värdesätts.Vi erbjuder:- Ett meningsfullt och varierande arbete med möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten. - En självständig chefsroll med stort utrymme att planera och strukturera det egna arbetet. - Ett nära samarbete med verksamhetschefen och övriga enhetschefer i ledningsgruppen, där du får stöd och möjlighet till gemensam reflektion. - Heltidsarbete som i huvudsak utförs under kontorstid, med flexibilitet och möjlighet att påverka arbetstidens förläggning. - Epassi-personalförmån som stöd för välbefinnande och fritid. - En positiv, stödjande och välmående arbetsgemenskap med engagerade kollegor och ett gott samarbetsklimat. **Välkommen till Luna Familjecenter!**Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett nära och närvarande ledarskap med ett betydelsefullt arbete för barn och familjer. Du blir en viktig del av en organisation där vi tillsammans utvecklar verksamheten och arbetar för att skapa trygghet, delaktighet och positiva förändringar.**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**
