Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 2. studenog 2026. godine. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro
  • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA METALNIH KONSTRUKCIJA
jobs.description: Poslodavac radi na projektima samoposlužnih autopraonica, self-storage objekata, metalnih konstrukcija i drugih specijaliziranih sustava diljem Europe. Opis posla: montaža metalnih konstrukcija, skladišnih jedinica i mezanina. Samostalno korištenje odgovarajućih ručnih alata i mjernih uređaja u svakodnevnom radu - rad u timu. Nije fizički težak posao i nema podizanje teških tereta. Održavanje visoke razine sigurnosti na radu i standarda rada. Samostalno identificiranje i rješavanje problema i zadataka. Poslodavac traži osobu koja želi dugoročno razvijati svoje montažerske vještine, spremna je učiti nove sustave i prihvaća odgovornost za svoj rad. Posao zahtijeva spremnost na rad na terenu i višednevna putovanja, sposobnost rada prema tehničkim uputama te uredan odnos prema alatu, opremi i kvaliteti izvedbe. Iskustvo u montaži je prednost, ali nije uvjet. Puno su nam važniji želja za učenjem, pouzdanost i spremnost na preuzimanje odgovornosti. Posao koji napravimo ostaje iza nas godinama i zato nam nije svejedno tko ga radi. Ne tražimo osobu koji već sve zna. Puno nam je važnije da želite učiti, da znate poslušati iskusnijeg kolegu i da nemate problem pitati kada nešto ne znate. Nitko od nas nije počeo znajući ovaj posao. Mjesto rada: Francuska (Saint Ettiene, Lambesc, Pariz) Kod nas nećete imati šefa koji će cijeli dan stajati iza Vas i govoriti Vam što trebate raditi. Imat ćete voditelja koji će prvi pokazati kako očekujemo da se radi. Od Vas očekujemo da učite, pamtite, preuzimate odgovornost i da iz dana u dan postajete sve samostalniji. Ako ne znate, slobodno pitajte. Ako pogriješite, recite. Ako vidite bolji način, predložite ga. Ali prvo naučite standard po kojem radimo. Tek kada ga razumijete, možete ga unaprijediti. Ne tražimo pomoćnog/u montera/ku za cijeli radni vijek. Ako pokažete da želite učiti i da se na Vas može računati, vrlo brzo ćete dobiti više odgovornosti. Kod nas se napreduje zato što ste spremni, a ne zato što je prošlo određeno vrijeme. Odnos prema poslu nam je jednako važan kao i znanje. Čuvamo alat. Pomažemo kolegi kada zapne. Ne skrivamo greške nego ih rješavamo. Poštovanje se kod nas ne dobiva radnim mjestom, nego načinom na koji radite i kako se odnosite prema ljudima. Ne možemo Vam obećati da će svaki projekt biti lagan. Možemo Vam obećati da ćete raditi uz ljude koji će podijeliti svoje znanje, dati Vam priliku da napredujete i cijeniti Vaš trud. Ako se dokažete, dobit ćete ono što se najteže stječe – povjerenje. Ako ste se prepoznali u ovome, pošaljite nam svoju prijavu. Možda upravo Vi tražite nas, a mi tražimo Vas. Uvjeti/poželjno: Tražimo osobu koja želi dugoročno razvijati svoje montažerske vještine, spremna je učiti nove sustave i prihvaća odgovornost za svoj rad. Posao zahtijeva spremnost na rad na terenu i višednevna putovanja, sposobnost rada prema tehničkim uputama te uredan odnos prema alatu, opremi i kvaliteti izvedbe. Iskustvo u montaži je prednost, ali nije uvjet. Puno su nam važniji želja za učenjem, pouzdanost i spremnost na preuzimanje odgovornosti.

jobs.title: MONTER/KA DIZALA
jobs.description: Mjesto rada: Slovenija (izaslani radnici) i Hrvatska Prednost imaju kandidati s iskustvom u montaži dizala. Zbog povećanog opsega projekata tražimo iskusne montere dizala za rad na projektima u Sloveniji, uz mogućnost rada i na projektima u Hrvatskoj. Pozivamo na prijavu i pomoćne montere s tehničkim iskustvom koji žele dugoročno raditi i razvijati se u području montaže dizala. Opis posla: • montaža dizala na projektima u Sloveniji i Hrvatskoj • izvođenje montažnih radova prema tehničkoj dokumentaciji i uputama • korištenje ručnih i električnih alata • suradnja s ostalim članovima montažnog tima • pridržavanje pravila i standarda zaštite na radu Koga tražimo? Za poziciju montera: • prethodno iskustvo u montaži dizala • sposobnost samostalnog obavljanja montažnih radova • dobro poznavanje i sigurno korištenje alata • odgovornost, pouzdanost i spremnost na timski rad Za poziciju pomoćnog montera: • poželjno iskustvo na montažnim, građevinskim, elektro ili srodnim tehničkim poslovima • sposobnost rukovanja alatima • motiviranost za učenje i napredovanje • odgovornost i spremnost na terenski rad Poslodavac nudi: • stabilno i dugoročno zaposlenje • organiziran i plaćen smještaj kada je potreban zbog mjesta rada • organiziran i pokriven prijevoz vezan uz rad na projektima • osiguranu radnu i zaštitnu opremu • redovita i stimulativna primanja • stručnu podršku i dodatne edukacije • mogućnost napredovanja unutar tvrtke Iskusnim monterima nudimo mogućnost preuzimanja veće odgovornosti na projektima i daljnjeg napredovanja prema poziciji voditelja tima. Ako već imate iskustva u montaži dizala i tražite stabilan posao na dugoročnim projektima, želimo vas upoznati. Ako još nemate iskustva s dizalima, ali imate tehničko iskustvo, znate raditi s alatima i želite naučiti posao, također nam se možete javiti.

jobs.title: POMOĆNI/A MONTER/KA / MONTER/KA DIZALA
jobs.description: Opis posla: • pomoćni poslovi pri ugradnji dizala (vodilice, kabina, vrata, strojarnica, kabliranje) • priprema i prijenos materijala i alata • bušenje, sidrenje i mehanička montaža prema uputama montera • održavanje urednosti na gradilištu i poštivanje propisa zaštite na radu Uvjeti: • spremnost na rad i boravak u inozemstvu • spremnost na fizički rad i rad na visini • prednost imaju kandidati/kinje tehničkih zanimanja (bravari/ce, strojari/ke, instalateri/ke, električari/ke, mehatroničari/ke) te kandidati/kinje s iskustvom u montaži dizala Plaća: fiksna plaća + bonus po učinku Poslodavac nudi: • obuku za montažu dizala i mogućnost napredovanja do samostalnog/e montera/ke • uskrsnicu i božićnicu • jubilarne nagrade • otpremninu pri odlasku u mirovinu • dugoročno zaposlenje uz kontinuitet projekata Poslodavac snosi troškove puta do mjesta rada i natrag, smještaja u vlastitoj sobi te prijevoza od smještaja do gradilišta. Mjesto rada: Luksemburg, Luksemburg Izaslani radnici. Rad se odvija u turnusima od približno 2,5 do 3 mjeseca terenskog rada i oko dva tjedna boravka kod kuće.

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.



The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.



In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.



As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8-12+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

Darba pienākumi var ietvert arī citus vienkāršus ēku, dzīvojamo, saimniecības vai ražošanas ēku remonta darbus.

French-speaking Sales Executive - Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Native French speaker, fully remote

Work tasks: Condor Automation is a growing company selling to industrial customers all over Europe. We help factories keep their machines running by finding the automation parts they urgently need: PLCs, HMIs, drives, servo drives, motors, electronic boards and sensors from brands such as Siemens, Omron, Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider and ABB. Our speciality is the obsolete and hard-to-find parts that local distributors can't supply. We are looking for an ambitious French-speaking Sales Executive to help us grow in France and Belgium. This is a real chance to grow with the company: your results will be seen, valued and rewarded. You will: - Find and contact new B2B customers (factories, maintenance teams, OEMs and integrators) by phone and email - Follow up enquiries and quotes and close sales - Build long-term relationships with existing customers - Work closely with the purchasing team to offer fast and competitive quotes - Keep customer and sales activity up to date in our CRM (Odoo)

We offer: - EUR 2,500 gross monthly salary + uncapped commission - there is no limit to what you can earn - Flexible hours: organise your day around your life, while covering our customers' needs - A real work-family balance, with a team that supports you when life happens - Work from home, anywhere in Estonia - 100% remote - Full training on our products, sales techniques and tools - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow as the company grows We are a small, international team spread across the UK, Italy and Spain. We believe people do their best work when their life outside work is looked after too. If you are a parent, you can give your best at work knowing the team has your back when something comes up at home.

Other requirements: The team works in English; you will speak to customers in French. - Native French (essential) - Good working English to communicate with the team - Proven experience in B2B sales of industrial, electrical or automation products - An existing network of industrial customers in France or Belgium is a strong advantage - Confident on the phone and good at following up - Organised, proactive and comfortable working remotely and independently - Technical knowledge of industrial automation is a plus - we will train you on our products - Resident in Estonia

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our NY office during this time.



Please only apply to the internship role that best fits your interest / experience. Multiple applications may result in delayed review of your application.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Web Infrastructure team’s mission is to own the foundation of Notion’s web-based clients and to empower engineers to build performant, scalable, and accessible product experiences within them.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU COULD:

 - Build and optimize common web patterns that front-end engineers can use to create features

 - Build tooling that allows engineers to test, debug, and profile front-end features

 - Build desktop infrastructure that is scalable and has deep OS integrations.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before Summer 2028.

 - Working toward proficiency in React / TypeScript

 - Previous internship experience.

 - You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our NY office during this time.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck.

 - Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - AI enthusiast: You have built or prototyped features with AI technologies (LLMs, Embeddings, ML) and are interested in learning more.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have expertise with specific technologies that are part of our stack, including TypeScript and React.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated hourly range for this role is $57/hr for Bachelors and $61/hr for Master’s.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

jobs.title: Fast ufaglært afløser til team hos respiratorbruger i Vodskov
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde 1:1 med din arbejdsleder og har du mulighed for at tage vagter med kort varsel, kan du være den rigtige person til denne stilling. 

Som respiratorisk hjælper får du et meningsfuldt job med et stort ansvar, for at din arbejdsleders liv, som et svært fysisk handicappet menneske med muskelsvind, kan fungere. 

Arbejdsleder er en kvinde på 74 år, der søger en fast afløser til respiratorisk overvågning, personlig pleje, praktisk hjælp og ledsagelse. 

•       Du kan tilhøre alle aldersgrupper og begge køn.

•       Du er rolig, ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

•       Du kan udføre de daglige arbejdsopgaver i et respektfuldt samarbejde.

•       Du har selv et godt liv, med interesse for mennesker og en god indlevelsesevne. 

•       Du har en udpræget praktisk sans og er god til rutiner.

•       Du ryger ikke.

•       Du har kørekort B, kørerutine og tør køre en stor bil.

•       Du vil fremvise din straffeattest.

Inden du får selvstændige vagter, vil du blive grundigt oplært i både det plejemæssige og det respiratoriske. Efter endt oplæring tilbydes du akutte vagter ved sygefravær samt afløsning i ferieperioder. Vagterne vil være på skiftende ugedage – også på skæve helligdage.  For at kunne opretholde rutine i de respiratoriske opgaver, vil du få en fast vagt hver 4. lørdag.

Stillingen er ufaglært, med en grundtimeløn på 161,87 kr. Der gives tillæg for vagter på lørdage, søndage og helligdage, desuden gives der arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg aften og nat. BPA Nord er arbejdsgiver.

Send din ansøgning i e-mail, med en beskrivelse af dig selv, dit cv og et vellignende foto. Ansøgningen sendes til: LK@bpa-nord.dk . Eventuelle spørgsmål rettes også hertil.

Den seneste frist for ansøgning er d. 1/12 - 26, men søg gerne før. Samtaler afholdes løbende og stillingen besættes når den rette person er fundet. Er du ikke inviteret til en personlig samtale inden d. 15/12 – 26, er stillingen besat til anden side.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. 

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms 

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

Learn how we think and work

In this strategic role, you will define and guide the future architecture of our data, analytics, artificial intelligence, master data management, API, and integration capabilities, ensuring they enable business growth, operational excellence, and digital transformation.As a Domain Architect, you will focus on long-term architecture vision, target-state design, governance, and roadmaps rather than individual project delivery. You will work closely with business leaders, product teams, architects, and technology specialists to ensure that enterprise capabilities evolve in a consistent, scalable, and business-driven manner.The position can be based at our Helsinki or Nokia office.What You Will Do- Develop and drive domain architecture roadmaps aligned with business strategy and enterprise architecture objectives.- Establish architecture principles, standards, and governance for data, AI, APIs, and integrations.- Develop and maintain architectural artefacts, like conceptual data models, integration diagrams and data flow diagrams.- Guide the evolution of modern data platforms, analytics capabilities, master data management and AI solutions.- Lead the development of integration strategies, API standards, and event-driven architecture patterns.- Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into architecture initiatives and capability improvements.- Support technology investment decisions and platform selection from an architectural perspective.- Review solution designs and provide guidance to ensure alignment with enterprise and domain architecture standards.- Identify and mitigate architectural risks, technical debt, and technology complexity- Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for business value creation.What We Are Looking For- Strong experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or a similar architecture role.- Deep understanding in some of the areas: data platforms, analytics, master data management, AI, integration architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies.- Experience developing target architectures, architecture roadmaps, and technology strategies.- Experience participating in large digital transformations, like data platform modernizations or ERP implementations in architect role.- Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methods such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, or capability-based planning.- Ability to engage both business and technology stakeholders and communicate complex topics clearly.- Strong strategic thinking and the ability to balance immediate business needs with long-term architectural goals.- Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or other complex business environments is considered an advantage.- Experience in related technologies, like Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Oracle SOA, Oracle Service Bus, SQL Server and Ellie.ai, is considered an advantage.Success in This RoleYou will help create a scalable and future-ready foundation for data, AI, and integrations across the enterprise. Your work will ensure that technology investments are aligned with business priorities, architectural complexity is reduced, and data and AI capabilities can be leveraged consistently across the organization.Our way of workingOur talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.Please note that prerequisite of the employment is that the selected employee has a valid residence and work permit in Finland.Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?Please fill in the application form, including your CV and salary request by 22 November 2026.For further information, please contact: Tuomas Suni, tel +358 50 3068378,e-mail tuomas.suni@nokiantyres.com.

jobs.title: Handledare, Octavens verksamhetscenter
jobs.description: Arbetet på Octavens verksamhetscenter är i allmän arbetstid, dagjobb från måndag till fredag. Octavens serviceenhet på Lästmakarvägen 19, är en svenskspråkig enhet som erbjuder dagverksamhet för personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 25 servicetagare i fem basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vikarierande handledare till vårt team på åtta personal. Som handledare planerar och föreverkligar du verksamhet i grupp och utvecklar meningsfullt innehåll i servicetagares vardag på enheten.Hos oss arbetar vi socialpedagogiskt, med fokus på servicetagares delaktighet, självbestämmande och valfrihet. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och värdesätter ett positivt förhållningssätt, lyhördhet inför servicetagares behov och förmåga att arbeta serviceinriktat. Du motiveras av att jobba med människor, har ett gott bemötande och en öppen attityd.Du kommer i först hand att jobba i en basgrupp som erbjuder sysselsättning i varierande former, men även enskilt med personer inom autismspektrumet. Du bör vara trygg i dig själv och din arbetsroll samt förstå innebörden av lågaffektivt bemötande. I arbetet ingår också hjälp och stöd i personlig vård. Har du erfarenhet eller intresse av att lära dig om arbete med personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer så är du den rätta personen för oss. Förutom ett intressant och varierande arbete erbjuder vi dig omfattande utbildnings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som anställd inom staden kan du ansöka om en hyreslägenhet på Auroraborg, där lägenheterna är billigare än marknadspris och våra anställdas ansökningar prioriteras.Eftersom livet inte bara handlar om arbete, ser vi också till balansen mellan arbete och fritid. Du får tillgång till Epassi Flex-paketet, som inkluderar förmåner för motion, kultur, arbetsresor och välbefinnande. Dessutom får du lunchförmån. Som personalförmån får du även tillgång till en stadscykel och du kan om du vill besöka stadens anställdas egna fritidsö.Behörighetskrav:Behörighetsvillkoren för en handledare är lämplig yrkeshögskoleexamen (till exempel socionom eller ergoterapeut) eller motsvarande tidigare examen på institutnivå. Den sökande bör uppvisa ett intyg över registrering hos Valvira.Spårkkravet är goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska och nöjaktiga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finska.Den sökande ska före antagningsbeslutet förete företagshälsovårdens bedömning om sina förutsättningar att sköta uppgiften.Personen som blir vald till tjänsten måste före arbetsförhållandet börjar presentera arbetsgivaren med ett bevis på drogtest.I uppgiften krävs vaccineringsskydd enligt lag om smittsamma sjukdomar 48 §, samt utredning över tuberkulos enligt 55§.I uppgiften krävs att MiniLop-läkemedelstillståndet genomförs godkänt inom prövotiden.Den som blir vald till tjänsten bör innan hen tar emot tjänsten, uppvisa ett brottsregisterutdrag för dem som arbetar med personer med funktionsnedsättning (lagen om tillsyn över social- och hälsovårdstjänster 741/2023, 28 §).Vi räknar som en merit:Tidigare erfarenhet med målgruppen.Vi värdesätter mångfald och jämställdhet i vår arbetsgemenskap. Vi välkomnar sökande av olika åldrar och kön, personer med funktionsnedsättning samt personer som tillhör olika språkliga, kulturella eller eventuellt andra minoriteter. Vi strävar efter att garantera en lättillgänglig rekryteringsprocess för alla sökande. Om du behöver anpassningar eller har önskemål gällande tillgängligheten under ansökningsprocessen, kan du kontakta oss via e-post på: sotepe.monimuotoinen.rekrytointi@hel.fi. Meddelandena hanteras separat från den rekryterande enheten, och kontakten vidarebefordras inte till den rekryterande förpersonen utan den sökandes samtycke.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö
jobs.description: Primary location:TUUSULAHaemme asiakkuuspäällikköä Meira Novan kaupalliseen organisaatioon. Vastaat yhdestä strategisesti merkittävimmistä asiakkuuksistamme, sen kasvusta ja kannattavuudesta sekä johdat asiakkuuteen nimettyä tiimiä. Kaupallisen johtoryhmän jäsenenä olet mukana suuntaamassa kaupallista toimintaamme.Tehtävässäsi keskeistä on varmistaa asiakkuuden myynti, tuloksellisuus ja toimitusvarmuus. Kehität yhteistyötä asiakkaan kanssa ja viet havaitsemasi kehitystarpeet eteenpäin omassa organisaatiossamme. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat asiakasvalikoimien hallinta, hinnoittelu sekä osallistuminen kysynnän ja tarjooman suunnitteluun. Tavoitteenasi on kannattava kasvu ja korkea asiakastyytyväisyys.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Vakuutat meidät kaupallisilla näytöilläsi: olet kasvattanut olemassa olevaa BtoB-asiakkuutta kannattavasti ja pystyt osoittamaan osaamisesi vaativissa kaupallisissa neuvotteluissa. Arvostamme foodservice-alan tuntemusta sekä kykyä ymmärtää asiakkaan liiketoimintaa ja tunnistaa yhteistyön kehittämismahdollisuuksia.Toivomme sinulta asiakaslähtöistä, tuloshakuista ja itsenäistä työotetta, erinomaisia neuvottelu-, vuorovaikutus- ja esiintymistaitoja sekä kykyä vaikuttaa sisäisiin ja ulkoisiin sidosryhmiin. Osaat johtaa ihmisiä ja kehittää toimintaa. Sinulla on noin kymmenen vuoden kokemus vastaavista vaativista asiakkuus-, myynti- tai liiketoimintatehtävistä ja vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto. Eduksi on järjestelmäosaaminen, esimerkiksi ERP-järjestelmät, Power BI ja Salesforce.Tule voittavaan joukkueeseenPääset osaksi Meira Novan noin 50 ammattilaisen kaupallista yksikköä, jossa osaamista jaetaan, työkaveria autetaan ja onnistutaan yhdessä. Haluamme, että ihmisemme viihtyvät, kehittyvät ja voivat olla ylpeitä työstään. Saat lisäksi käyttöösi S-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut: https://s-ryhma.fi/tyopaikat/erinomaiset-edutKiinnostuitko?Hae tehtävää oheisella hakulomakkeella viimeistään 22.11.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa kaupallinen johtaja Arja Liimatainen puhelimitse 010 768 6511. Parhaiten Arjan tavoittaa tiistaina 10.11. klo 15–16 tai perjantaina 13.11. klo 14–15.Meira Nova on vuonna 1991 perustettu foodservice-alan toimitustukku ja SOK:n tytäryhtiö. Palvelemme yli 200 ammattilaisen voimin ravintoloita, hotelleja, henkilöstöravintoloita, terveys- ja hoivapalveluita sekä julkishallintoa kaikkialla Suomessa. Logistiikkakeskuksemme sijaitsee Tuusulassa.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, Benelux
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in Dutch.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   
   



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €210,000 - €222,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

For our client, we are looking for a Business Cutover Lead.

jobs.title: Junior Finance Controller
jobs.description:
Kick-start your finance career in a growing international technology company.

As our new Junior Finance Controller, you will gain hands-on experience with finance operations, SAP processes, and financial controls while working closely with experienced colleagues in an innovative and globally expanding organization.

Based at our headquarters in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, you will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Finance Operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career finance professional to develop both technical finance expertise and business understanding in a high-tech international environment. The role supports our continued growth and integration within the Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation group.

You will be part of an ambitious company where we win together. Team spirit and mutual success are key components in our everyday work culture.

Tasks and responsibilities

Support Finance OperationsSupport daily SAP Finance activities, including transaction processing, master data validation, and basic troubleshooting to ensure efficient finance operations.

Manage Invoice Processing

Help ensure incoming invoices are processed accurately and on time while maintaining high standards of financial control and compliance.

Maintain Process Documentation

Prepare, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other finance process documentation in line with group standards and best practices.

Contribute to Continuous Improvement

Support the standardization and continuous improvement of finance processes and frameworks across the organization.

Support Month-End Closing

Assist with journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation as part of the monthly financial closing process.

Participate in Ad Hoc Projects

Contribute to various finance and administrative projects and tasks as required by the team.

Skills, experiences and qualifications we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 1-2 years of relevant experience within finance, accounting, or a similar function.
  • Understanding of fundamental accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop professionally.
  • Experience working with SAP FI or another ERP system.
  • Exposure to process documentation and SOP development.
  • Experience from an international company or shared service environment.

Questions You are welcome to reach out to hiring manager: Michael Forster, Head of Finance Operations, mifo@nilt.com

Interested?

Please forward your CV and application letter incl. answers to the 2 questions below, no later than 23 November 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

1. Key experience #1

ERP Systems

Please describe your experience with SAP or other ERP systems. What tasks have you performed, and what did you learn from the experience?

2. Key experience #2

Accounting and Financial Processes

Please provide an example of a finance or accounting task you have handled where attention to detail was particularly important. What was your role and what was the outcome?

About NIL Technology

NIL Technology (NILT), founded in 2006, is an optical solutions company designing, developing, and manufacturing optical elements and components using high-precision nanoscale features. NILT creates competitive advantages with flat optics (meta-optics) in optical applications for 3D sensing, consumer electronics, machine vision, autonomous vehicles, telecommunication, and AR. With its background in mastering and nanoimprint, the company produces masters and offers nano-foundry services. NILT is based in Denmark and has offices in Switzerland, Sweden, Finland, US, and a manufacturing in Malaysia. NILT is owned by Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation (www.radiant.com.tw).

Visit us at www.nilt.com.).

jobs.title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

  • Design and implement preventive and systemic interventions at class and year-group levels to promote student wellbeing and positive group dynamics.

  • Develop, implement and review individual student support plans in alignment with the IB Access and Inclusion Policy.

  • Collaborate with the student wellbeing team, student support staff, teachers and parents to coordinate appropriate support.

  • Guide students and families through the Danish public and private healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR, specialist clinics and pathways to diagnostic assessment.

  • Prepare professional referrals and supporting documentation for external assessments, including neuropsychological or psychiatric evaluations, within the scope of professional competence.

  • Follow safeguarding, confidentiality and data protection requirements; identify students requiring specialist intervention and coordinate appropriate follow-up and support.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Relevant qualifications and training in psychology, counselling or social-emotional support. A qualification as a psychologist, including assessment and diagnosis, is preferred; demonstrated expertise in social-emotional counselling will also be considered.

  • Knowledge of the Danish healthcare and youth support systems, including PPR.

  • Experience with psychological screening and assessment tools such as WISC, WAIS, BASC, and BRIEF is an advantage.

  • Experience working within the International Baccalaureate (IB) system is desirable but not required.

jobs.title: Researcher in Biostatistics
jobs.description:
About the position

We are seeking applicants with a strong methodological background in biostatistics and causal inference for a 3-year 20% researcher position in Biostatistics, in a project on causal inference for effects of health related interventions on working life outcomes, at the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology (OCBE), Department of Biostatistics, University of Oslo (UiO).

OCBE is one of Europe's most active biostatistics groups with currently about 80 researchers. OCBE is internationally recognized, with interests spanning a broad range of areas, including causal inference and time-to-event analysis, clinical trials, epidemiology, high dimensional statistics, infectious disease, machine learning and mathematical modelling. The centre has numerous collaborations with leading biomedical research groups internationally and in Norway.

More about the position

The candidate will be part of the research group on causal inference and survival analysis led by professor Jon Michael Gran, where they will work on causal inference with applications to longitudinal data from large population-wide registries. The position is connected to the project “Improving causal inference for individual working life trajectories from registry data: studying interventions, estimands and heterogeneity”, funded by the Research Council of Norway (RCN). The project is a close collaboration with research groups at the National Institute of Occupational Health (STAMI) and Oslo University Hospital (OUS).

The candidate will pursue research on causal inference for treatment effect estimation from complex longitudinal data, collected from various population wide registries. An emphasis will be made on exposure measurement error, interference, effect heterogeneity and the analysis of individual outcome trajectories. However, other methods may also be relevant. Methods should be motivated in and applied to answering the subject matter research questions of the overall project, such as of the effects of interventions for a more inclusive working life (including rehabilitation measures and work place facilitation) or the effects of sustained medical treatments (including use of opioids and other type of pain treatment for patients after traumatic injury). Outcomes of interest will be related to long term health, sick leave and work participation. 

The candidate’s role in the project will be both to supervise other project members and to conduct own methodological and applied research in biostatistics. We provide an exciting and friendly research environment for the development and application of new methods in a collaborative and interdisciplinary fashion, with various national and international collaborators. The candidate will work closely with other project members at OCBE, STAMI and OUS, other external collaborators, and the causal inference and survival analysis group at OCBE. The candidate will participate in regular project meetings and must have the ability to work well in a multi-disciplinary team.

The candidate’s workplace will be at OCBE’s premises in the UiO building Domus Medica.

Preferred starting date for the position is January 1st, 2027. 

Qualifications requirements

Required quialifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree corresponding to a Norwegian doctoral degree in biostatistics or statistics. 
  • A broad background from methodological research in causal inference is required. 
  • Strong quantitative and computational skills is required. Applicants should be fluent in R or equivalent software.
  • Experience with interdisciplinary collaborations and student supervision at PhD level is required. 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience within areas relevant for the project will be an advantage.
  • Experience with analysis of large datasets is an advantage. Experience with biomedical applications is also an advantage.
  • Personal suitability will be emphasized.

Language requirements:

  • Working language in the group and at OCBE is English. Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.
Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently.
  • Good communication and collaborative skills.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 

We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A friendly, ambitious and international working environment.
  • Attractive welfare benefits and a generous pension agreement, in addition to Oslo’s family-friendly environment with its rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 670 000 - 775 000, depending on competence and experience. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

Application

Your application must include:

  • Application letter with a short statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education and relevant experience).
  • A complete list of publications
  • Transcripts and certificates
  • List of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge, please follow the link: “Apply for this job”. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their University's grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. Applicants may be called in for an interview.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to  Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

jobs.title: Fortegaardens private plejecenter søger en fast aftenvagt.
jobs.description:
Er du uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent og funger du arbejdsmæssigt bedst om aftenen?

Vil du være med til at skabe en god hverdag, med hyggelige aftenstunder for vores beboere?

Kan du lide at sætte din faglighed i spil hver dag? Samt være en del af fællesskabet, hvor tværfaglig sparring er en del af hverdagen?

Så er du måske vores nye aftenvagt .

 

Plejecenter Fortegaarden er en selvejende institution, beliggende i Risskov, tæt ved letbanen og busforbindelser og med gratis parkering. Vi har i alt 50 lejligheder, der er fordelt på 5 bo-enheder med 10 boliger i hver, hvor du primært bliver tilknyttet en enkelt bo-enhed, og hvor der også er ansat både sygeplejerske, terapeuter, rengøringspersonale samt andet sosu-uddannet personale. Via det daglige, tværfaglige samarbejde og planlagte borgergennemgange er der derfor rig mulighed for sparring.

 

Som aftenvagt vil du blive en del af et aftenvagtsteam på i alt 8, der er fordelt på de 5 bo-enheder, hvoraf én i teamet er ansvarshavende social-og sundhedsassistent. Dine arbejdsdage vil som udgangspunkt være mandag og tirsdag samt med weekendvagt i ulige uger.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område, og vil fortrinsvis at være i aftenvagt, men der vil på en 12 ugers plan forekomme 2 vagter, der vil ligge i et andet vagtlag efter aftale.

 

Kandidatens profil:

·       Du er autoriseret social-og sundhedsassistent.

·       Du arbejder helhedsorienteret og personcentreret med udgangspunkt i borgernes mål og ressourcer og med rehabilitering for øje.

·       Du er spontan og kreativ i dit arbejde, og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du er engageret og brænder du for at gøre en forskel i ældre menneskers hverdag og liv.

·       Du udforsker muligheder, ser ikke begrænsninger i en travl hverdag?

·       Du har et godt overblik og kan håndtere en varieret arbejdsdag.

·       Du kan lide faglige udfordringer, men er samtidig bevidst om egne kompetencer.

·       Du har et anerkendende menneskesyn, og i dit arbejde er du altid den bedste udgave af dig og din faglighed.

·       Du er fleksibel og langtidsfrisk.

·       Du har forståelsen for vigtigheden af den rette dokumentation, så kendskab til og anvendelse af CURA eller anden elektronisk journalføring vil være en fordel

·       Du taler og skriver forståeligt dansk

 

Om Fortegaarden:

Vores kerneopgave er: ”Fortegaarden - et meningsfuldt og attraktivt senior fælleskabe”. Her trives fællesskab og god vilje, vi er klar til udfordringer og vi kan se os selv leve her som ældre.

Hos os er vi alle med til at bidrage til det gode arbejdsmiljø. Vi vil skabe gode relationer med hinanden, både kollegaer imellem, til vores beboere og deres pårørende. Vi passer på hinanden i hverdagen, griner sammen men kan også være alvorlige når det kræves, og tør snakke om det der er svært.

Du skal derfor vælge/gribe muligheden for at arbejde hos os, da vi:

 

·       Kan tilbyde dig et spændende og selvstændigt job, hvor tværfaglig sparring, vidensdeling og nysgerrighed er en naturlig del hverdagen.

·       Har mange forskellige kompetencer, som vi bruger aktivt i hverdag med borgerne.

·       Prioriterer ledelsesmæssig opbakning og nærvær

·       Kan lide vores målgruppe, vi kan lide hinanden, og vi kan lide de udfordringer, der er på et plejecenter, fordi vi står sammen og tager et fælles ansvar for det gode arbejdsmiljø.

 

 

Ved ansættelse på Plejecenter Fortegaarden, får du adgang til fitness/træningsfaciliteter samt tilbudt en sundhedsforsikring, tilbydes flere årlige, sociale arrangementer, er en del af frugt- og kaffe/the ordning samt får rabat i Caféen.

Ansættelse pr. 1/01 2027 eller hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og slår til, når den rette kandidat har præsenteret sig.

Løn efter overenskomst og en kommende løntilpasning efter kompetencer.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen og Fortegaarden, kan du kontakte daglig leder Tine de Place, tlf. 5154 0634 eller daglig leder Karin Fenger Ellekrog, tlf. 5114 0810

jobs.title: Mekaaninen asentaja (Rauma)
jobs.description: Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!TehtävänkuvausHaemme asiakkaallemme Raumalle mekaanista asentajaa pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtehtävääsi kuuluu koneiden kokoonpano ja laitteiden asennustehtävät. Työt alkavat 6 kuukauden määräaikaisuudella, jonka jälkeen sopivalle työntekijälle tarjotaan vakituista paikkaa. Töitä tehdään arkipäivisin päivävuorossa klo 8-16. Työtä tehdään 37,5h/vk. Jos haluat päästä työskentelemään osana ammattimaista työporukkaa, niin hae mukaan!Toivomme sinultaSinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Monipuolinen alan työkokemus katsotaan eduksi sekä kaikenlainen koneasennuksen ja hydrauliikan tuntemus sekä autopuolen harrastuneisuus. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.Tarjoamme sinulleTarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!Contio HenkilöstöpalvelutSähköposti: joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Rauma
